Our founding bears the signature of our founder, the Great Leader Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, whose vision and values are respected around the world.

We expand our activities, which started in 1935 as a pioneering symbol of his goal of production-based development, by adding value to every geography where we operate and every stakeholder whose life we touch.

In this journey that we started 87 years ago as one of Türkiye's pioneering industrialization moves, today we are one of the strongest players in the glass and chemicals sectors in the global arena.

Inspired by the transformative power of our founder, we work day and night for a better future with our more than 24 thousand employees located in 14 countries across four continents.

In the 100 th  anniversary of the Turkish Republic, we proudly carry the unique vision of our founder to more than 150 countries around the globe.

'Paramparça' created by contemporary visual artist Simon Berger with hammer blows on glass to commemorate Atatürk on November 10, 2022.

## A Meaningful Memorial to Atatürk from Şişecam

To commemorate its founder, the Great Leader Atatürk, on the anniversary of his death in 2022, Şişecam produced a very special film. As part of this unique project where glass meets art, Şişecam commissioned the creation of a portrait of Atatürk with worldrenowned Swiss contemporary visual artist Simon Berger.

This special portrait, created with 4,028 hammer blows on glass, was first exhibited at Şişecam Headquarters and then exhibited to visitors at the Rahmi M. Koç Museum on December 22. The work attracted numerous visitors and generated great interest.

Şişecam's November 10 th commemoration film - titled 'Parampararça' and featuring the creation of the work by Simon Berger - was widely praised at the time of its release.

<!-- image -->

Broadcast on November 9, the film was viewed by an audience of thousands, in Türkiye and internationally.

'Paramparça' won the Most Admired Commercial Film of 2022 award at the 21 st  Altınyıldız Classics Stars of the Year Awards held by Yıldız Technical University and determined by the votes of 35,000 students. The unique video was also recognized by leading platforms in the field of marketing as the 'Best Digital Campaign of the Year.' 'Paramparça' was the subject of many news articles and received wide press coverage.

Şişecam's November 10 Atatürk Commemoration Film recorded a high reach on social media and was one of the most shared and viewed communication activities of the year.

## Şişecam Main Sponsor of the International Year of Glass

The United Nations declared 2022 as the 'International Year of Glass' and Şişecam assumed the main sponsorship.

Şişecam's Chairman and Executive Member of the Board Prof. Dr. Ahmet Kırman delivered the closing speech at the opening event of the 2022 International Year of Glass at the United Nations building in Geneva.

Prof. Dr. Kırman's speech touched on the role of glass in human history and its contribution to the development of civilizations. Prof. Dr. Kırman emphasized the importance of glass, which is a strategic material for the future as well as the present, having given its name to the year 2022. He explained Şişecam's technology- and sustainability-focused efforts that bring new capabilities and functions to glass, which has infinite potential.

To celebrate the Year of Glass and draw attention to its sustainability, Şişecam conducted a comprehensive communication campaign in Türkiye, Bulgaria, and Italy to explain the miracles of glass in every field and raise public awareness. As part of the communication plan, all Group brands, especially Şişecam's corporate brand, intensively communicated the Year of Glass throughout this reporting period.

Şişecam produced and broadcast a film on the miraculous properties of glass from the perspectives of sustainability and technology on digital channels and social media. The film was viewed more than 1.5 million times in Italy, Bulgaria, and Türkiye, and its social media activities reached nearly 60 million interactions. In addition, within the communication campaign, advertorial content was placed in leading business and economics magazines. Detailed exchanges were also made on the subject at conferences and seminars.

## Şişecam

## A global leader in glass and chemicals

Şişecam is an industrial enterprise conducting business operations in the core areas of flat glass, glassware, glass packaging, auto glass, and chemicals with more than 24 thousand employees in 14 countries around the globe. Şişecam sells its products in over 150 countries worldwide, with international sales accounting for more than half of its total sales.

Founded in 1935 by İşbank under the directive of Atatürk, Şişecam is one of the most established industrial organizations in Türkiye with its 87 years of corporate history. Due to its specialization, advanced technological capabilities, and numerous competitive advantages, Şişecam is one of the most prestigious manufacturers in the world today.

## Shareholder and Investor Relations

## A transparent and proactive approach toward investor relations

Two-way communications between investors and Şişecam

Embracing its vision and responsibility as a global company, Şişecam is committed to implementing worldclass investor relations and corporate governance practices with the primary objective of constantly increasing its shareholder value.

Şişecam Investor Relations' main responsibilities include increasing the shareholder value of Şişecam and taking the necessary steps to ensure that capital market instruments issued by Şişecam trade at their fair value. In line with these goals, Investor Relations uses many communications tools and platforms - such as websites, investor relations presentations, earnings reviews, webcasts, as well as participation in roadshows and conferences - to provide complete and accurate information on Şişecam's financial performance and results to all relevant parties. Additionally, shareholders are given updates on important developments in real-time via press releases and announcements made on the Public Disclosure Platform.

In 2022, Şişecam conducted its investor relations activities in a transparent, proactive, and expeditious way, with a focus on fair disclosure to all investors. This reporting year was dominated by an inflationary environment globally as well as rising input and energy costs, in addition to risks related to an energy crisis, a tightened monetary policy, and geopolitical shifts and tensions. For Şişecam, 2022 was marked by the organizational transformation and digitalization journey of the company's consolidated structure, along with new investment decisions and various steps taken to maximize stakeholder value. Throughout the year, Şişecam communicated extensively with all its stakeholders, including domestic and foreign individual and institutional investors, brokerage firms, credit rating agencies, and creditors. In 2022, Şişecam's investor communications included video and teleconferences planned by brokerage firms and investment banks in line with the 'new normal,' as well as in-person participation in roadshows and conferences. To this end, Şişecam attended 11 conferences and four roadshows, meeting with 255 current and potential domestic and foreign institutional equity and debt investors. Additionally, individual teleconferences were held with nearly 300 investors and analysts, demonstrating Şişecam's strong commitment to ongoing investor communications.

In total, over 550 investor meetings were held via telephone, one-on-one and group meetings, roadshows, as well as video and teleconferences. Şişecam conducted two webcasts in 2022 to announce its 2021 year-end and 2022 first-half financial results, where presentations were made to investors and analysts. These broadcasts reached an audience of nearly 300 investors. Transcripts of these webcasts, along with Q&amp;As directed at company management and the presentations delivered, were shared on the corporate website for investors and analysts who were unable to attend the webcasts. Şişecam continues to conduct webcasts regularly, at least twice a year.

This year saw the ongoing impact of the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MIFID) as many sell-side analysts publishing research reports at brokerage firms continued to join portfolio management firms. One new institution was added to the universe of brokerage firms covering Şişecam, with more than 120 reports published on the company throughout the year.

In Institutional Investor's 'Emerging EMEA Executive Team' survey - in which 250 publicly traded companies from 12 industries in 32 countries were rated by nearly 300 investors and analysts - Şişecam placed third among industrial enterprises on the buy side and sell side in the 'Best CEO,' 'Best CFO,' 'Best Investor Relations Program,' and 'Best Investor Relations Team' categories.

Türkiye Şişe ve Cam Fabrikaları A.Ş. continues to generate significant added value across all the industries and regions where it operates, while also creating value for its investors. In 2022, the proportion of Turkish stock held by foreign investors dropped from 41% to 30%. Meanwhile, the Borsa Istanbul 100 index completed the year with a 197% increase in value. During the year, Şişecam's share price went up by 227%, recording a low of TRY 11.51 and a high of TRY 43.04. Foreign investors' holdings of Şişecam shares declined from 33% at year-end 2021 to 25% at year-end 2022. Şişecam stock outperformed the market thanks to solid demand in its core business segments, ready access to global markets, a balanced portfolio of operations, strong financial performance, forwardlooking investment decisions, ongoing organizational and digital

## Agility to adapt to the new global paradigm

Şişecam's scenario-based strategic planning and implementation capabilities, as well as its data-driven decision-making mechanisms, are key factors of its success.

Dear Stakeholders,

For the past several years, the world has experienced sudden and dramatic changes that deeply impact our everyday lives. These difficult times bring about diverse catalysts for change at the least expected moments. Every day we are attempting to manage the unknown. The various risks and challenges that have grown more pronounced each year since 2020 also left their mark on 2022, the first year that pandemic-related uncertainties started to subside. Globally, ongoing socio-economic and geopolitical crises signaled the start of yet another challenging and volatile period. These risks have forced global enterprises to align more closely with a 'think globally/ act locally' approach. As pandemicrelated risks lessened somewhat in 2022, the business world once again focused on facing ongoing global problems.

## The world economy is slowing

As the year started out with expectations for macroeconomic volatility on many fronts - particularly high inflation - 2022 also saw a geopolitical and diplomatic crisis on a scope and scale not witnessed in Europe in many years. The RussiaUkraine War stirred up new crises across the world that required close attention and careful management. The business community was forced to try to solve its acute energy shortage while simultaneously managing sharply rising costs due to various embargoes imposed on Russia. Critical problems in global supply and logistics continued to cause major disruptions for businesses around the world. The global economy fell short of its previous rapid growth rate as of second quarter 2022.

Additionally, we are not expecting a magic formula to quickly revert to the pre-pandemic world, where more incremental change was the norm. Forecasts by international institutions suggest that the global economic growth rate of 6% seen in 2021 will drop to 3.2% in 2022 and slow further still to 2.7% in 2023. Economists have shared these figures to illustrate the current situation. This is likely the world's weakest economic growth outlook since 2001, except for the global financial crisis and the most acute phase of the Covid-19 pandemic.

Yet even in this more modest-growth climate, Şişecam successfully conducts its production operations in numerous locations - encompassing 14 countries across four continents - thanks to effective risk management and rational decision-making. As the company executes its strategies and moves toward its global objectives, Şişecam always keeps its finger on the pulse of the local environment. At each of its locations, Şişecam manages its operations by keeping an eye on regional risks and requirements. This approach gives Şişecam the agility and capabilities it needs to adapt to the new global paradigm. Şişecam thrives on intercultural interaction as it moves forward toward a shared vision with collective wisdom and expands its global footprint.

Şişecam's capabilities in scenario-based strategic planning and implementation, as well as its data-driven decisionmaking mechanisms, are key factors of its success. Guided by corporate risk management principles, Şişecam approaches risks with a holistic outlook. Thanks to the integrated structure of One Şişecam, the company also benefits from its innovative infrastructure brought about by digitalization at every site and location. As a result of its digitalization efforts, Şişecam is able to continuously monitor its operations in real-time and manage them much more easily and efficiently.

All these meticulous steps that we are taking to create the Şişecam of the Future are also reflected in our solid financial results.

## We are surpassing our business targets despite unfavorable conditions

In 2022, Şişecam's consolidated net sales revenue rose to TRY 95.3 billion. International sales accounted for 63% of the Group's consolidated sales revenue. During the year, the Group's exports totaled USD 1.1 billion. Şişecam achieves growth via capital investments. This year, our investment spending totaled TRY 7.8 billion. Our effective operational management, continuous transformation, and growth-oriented investments all played a role in the successful results we obtained at a time of global economic volatility and geopolitical uncertainties.

Şişecam's strong customer focus and effective supply chain management are just two of its primary competitive advantages. We believe in developing and transforming along with our ecosystem. As a global company, Şişecam performs exceptionally well in terms of meeting changing customer demands in different countries and efficiently managing supply conditions. In turn, Şişecam is able to meet market demands as quickly as possible in an increasingly challenging global trade environment. Our core principle is to generate added value for the economies of the countries and regions where we operate. This focus allows us to achieve success by acting as a local player in our markets and collaborating with local employees there. Thanks to this approach, Şişecam is making great strides in improving its service quality day by day. The Group is achieving and maintaining an optimal balance of production, sales, and inventory thanks in part to the holistic management and continuous improvement of its digital systems and infrastructures.

Our inclusive work culture also boosts Şişecam's performance. Our corporate culture is playing a strategic role in the Group's target of becoming one of the world's top three players in its main business segments.

For quite some time now, our planet has been sounding the alarm. Humankind is trying to solve the myriad problems facing the planet - such as the food crisis, energy shortages, and climate change - with circular methods, such as recycling or reuse, that allow for more efficient use of resources. Today, the world economy is only about 8.6% circular, leaving a massive circularity gap. However, glass is the best solution to meet our planet's needs. Glass can be 100% recycled countless times. As a unique material that plays a key role in many fields - from transportation to housing, architecture to energy, healthcare to communications - glass features a variety of uses that directly serve the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals. Meanwhile, the glass industry is a driver of economies as a source of employment, production, and exports. With a constantly evolving and expanding set of uses, glass generates long-term value in the industries for which it provides input. In short, glass offers endless potential to create a sustainable future.

## Energy shortages and supply disruptions are squeezing glass production

The global glass industry's growth parallels the performance of the world economy. Production in the global glass market is expanding at a pace of nearly 4% per year. Flat glass accounts for 47% of world glass production, with glass packaging accounting for 46%, glassware for 4%, and glass fiber for 3%. As an energy-intensive sector, glass production is under increasing pressure due to energy shortages and supply disruptions. The architectural glass industry enjoys a positive outlook due in part to growing demand in the construction industry. The growth- and health-related trends in the tourism and consumer sectors after the pandemic have had a positive impact on the glass packaging and glassware segments. In the automotive industry, recovery efforts despite the computer chip shortage have yielded growth of about 2-3% per year in auto glass.

Dear Stakeholders,

In addition to being a major player in chemicals, Şişecam is the only global company to operate in all core areas of glass manufacturing. Aware of the immense responsibility that this unique position brings, Şişecam took a major step to emphasize and

<!-- image -->

generate awareness for the importance of glass as a miraculous material. We played a key role in the United Nations' declaration of 2022 as the International Year of Glass. At Şişecam, we believe that glass awareness should encompass not just one year but an entire century. Together with our stakeholders, we are developing strategic projects and initiatives that create social benefit to draw attention to the many advantages of glass.

Sustainability is a key focus area for Şişecam. We see sustainability as a strategic priority and approach the topic with great care and sensitivity. In line with its 2030 CareforNext sustainability strategy, Şişecam operates in accordance with the key concepts of 'Protecting the Planet,' 'Empowering Society,' and 'Transforming Life.' The company also undertakes significant efforts to to include its entire ecosystem in this transformation.

Şişecam's founder, the Great Leader Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, once stated, 'My spiritual legacy is science and reason.' Inspired by these words, we keep science and technology at the center of our corporate development. Şişecam aims to undertake intensive R&amp;D projects to serve its vision of a better world. We are highly committed to achieving our goal of net zero emissions by 2050. Our efforts to develop energy glass solutions, supply gas fiber as an input for wind turbines, and our energy-saving low-e glasses all directly contribute to this vision. Currently, Şişecam is working diligently on R&amp;D projects in advanced furnace control technologies, glass recycling, the use of renewable sources to produce electricity for our internal use, and innovative furnace technologies.

Dear Stakeholders,

2023 is sure to be yet another year marked by global volatility and uncertainties in many different areas. At Şişecam, we are well-positioned to emerge from such challenging periods even stronger thanks to our highly capable workforce, investments in smart technologies, appropriate strategies based on collective wisdom, and courage to take action. We are fully committed to growing further by adding value to all our stakeholders while sharing the mission and forward-looking vision of our founder to future generations in the best way possible.

As we leave behind a challenging year, we are proud to have reached our goals on every front. On behalf of the Board of Directors, I would like to thank Şişecam's 24 thousand employees in 14 countries across four continents for all their hard work, as well as all our stakeholders for their support in achieving such successful results.

The Şişecam Family shares the deep sorrow of the earthquake disaster that struck southeastern Türkiye on February 6, 2023. We unfortunately experienced some tragic losses among our Turkish employees' relatives, our business partners, our customers, and our suppliers. We share our deepest condolences with those who were impacted by the earthquakes. At Şişecam, we sincerely believe that we will overcome these difficult days through solidarity and togetherness.

## CEO's Message

## Proactive and quick decision-making capacity

2022 saw Şişecam record successful results both financially and operationally as an organization with strong risk management capabilities.

Dear Stakeholders,

We have exited a very challenging fiscal year. 2022 was a year of constant struggle. Risks remained largely intact worldwide. Ongoing global uncertainties rendered forecasting problematic at best. A newly emerging energy crisis due to geopolitical issues, elevated inflation, signs of recession, and sharply higher energy costs had a major impact on costs across many industries. Meanwhile, global demand and the positive trajectory of the world economy unfortunately fell short of expectations. All these factors contributed to a slowdown of growth in the global economy, leaving the business world to face a challenging period with diminished hopes for the future.

In times of crisis such as these, two capabilities must be present to achieve success without sharply veering from the game plan despite negative circumstances: foresight and agility. Şişecam moved forward on its journey of steady growth even in this challenging year where changing dynamics required revisions to its roadmap. We maintained our track record of success this difficult year thanks to our ability to readily adapt to change, our proactive management approach, and our quick decision-making capabilities. Through the hard work of our highly competent workforce of 24 thousand employees, we further enriched our 87-year corporate history with new accomplishments. As a company that regularly receives a high rating for corporate governance compliance, Şişecam combined its expertise in this key area with the strength of its transformation. Throughout the year, we once again demonstrated our world-class capabilities by undertaking investments and operations that generate sustainable value.

This reporting year, volatility and uncertainty were dominant worldwide and global economic growth fell far short of expectations. However, 2022 saw Şişecam obtain successful results both financially and operationally as an organization with strong risk management capabilities. We expertly managed the complexities of different regulations and economic conditions across a vast geography that spans 14 countries. Şişecam concluded the year by surpassing its goals thanks to its scenario-based strategies as well as its proactive and quick decision-making capacity.

In 2022, Şişecam reported consolidated net sales revenue of TRY 95.3 billion. International sales accounted for 63% of total sales. Our investments throughout the year totaled TRY 7.8 billion. Şişecam's exports totaled USD 1.1 billion.

Taking quick action and adapting to change are two of our strongest competitive advantages… Thanks to its core competencies and capabilities, Şişecam was able to move quickly and review its strategies in the face of suddenly changing conditions as well as macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainties in 2022. Our causality- and results-oriented approach enabled Şişecam to move forward with rational and inclusive strategies that encompassed its entire ecosystem. Despite operating a heavy-industry business, Şişecam benefited from the advantages of its agile management approach. During this challenging year, we continued our operations without interruption. In short, we demonstrated our strength as a global player and obtained successful operational results. Driven by our objective of creating sustainable value, we produced 5.8 million tons of glass, 4.9 tons of soda ash, and 4.4 million tons of industrial raw materials in 2022.

Dear Stakeholders,

Şişecam is one of the biggest enterprises to emerge from Türkiye and the surrounding geography. Since our founding, we have always made it a priority to be ready for tomorrow. As we work constantly and meticulously to change and transform into the Şişecam of the Future, we are continuously improving - as inspired by our founder, the Great Leader Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, whose vision and values are respected worldwide.

In today's world, effective use of data, the ability to make quick decisions, and systematic management of analytical decision-making mechanisms are required to stand out from the competition. This fact is precisely why we believe in the importance of digitalization. In 2015, Şişecam embarked on a comprehensive transformation journey. Our aim was to achieve a simpler, more agile, more flexible structure for the company with digital and operational excellence. Along our journey of digital and organizational transformation, we primarily focused on digitalization with the Roots and Wings project. Noted by SAP as one of the world's most large-scale and all-encompassing digital transformation projects to emerge in recent years, this transformation initiative also improved Şişecam's ability to manage its operations with data and numbers. After meeting a significant portion of its digital transformation objectives in 2021, Şişecam moved forward with additional projects focused on smart technologies and digitalization in 2022. Upon completion of this massive and comprehensive transformation initiative by year-end 2024, Şişecam will boast the most integrated technological infrastructure in the world, using smart technologies to stand apart from the competition in all its business segments.

Şişecam makes a difference through the power of transformation and decisions guided by collective wisdom. In 2022, we met market demands quickly in an increasingly challenging global trade environment. At the same time, Şişecam made major strides in boosting its level of service. To that end, we focused on key account management as well as effective sales and operational planning to successfully balance production, sales, and inventory with the help of digital solutions.

We also remained committed to making investments that further strengthen our business operations and ecosystem. In the first quarter of 2022, Şişecam acquired the Italian refractory manufacturer Refel to guarantee the sustainability of its investments. Shortly afterward, we broke ground on our Hungarian facility - Şişecam's first European investment in glass packaging. Planned to be equipped with advanced technologies that reduce our carbon and water footprint, this new production facility will also serve as a local manufacturer in the European market.

The multidimensional fluctuations in the current business cycle have also disrupted the energy supply and demand balance. This, in turn, led to rising natural gas, electricity, and fuel costs, boosting demand for renewable energy sources that cost less than fossil fuels. Driven by this elevated demand, the global installed capacity

for solar power is expected to quadruple to over 3 thousand GW by 2030. The falling costs of producing electricity from solar resources coupled with a growing worldwide focus on sustainability are creating an array of new opportunities in the patterned glass and energy glass industries. At Şişecam, we are empowered by our risk prediction capabilities as well as our ability to take advantage of emerging opportunities. Recognizing an opportunity in this segment, Şişecam announced in July that it would invest in a patterned glass furnace and processing line at its Mersin plant. Before year's end, we made a second announcement about a capacity expansion for this new furnace and processing line. With this latest capital investment, the capacity of the second patterned glass furnace in Mersin - where we will also produce energy glass - will increase from 180 thousand tons to 244 thousand tons per year. Meanwhile, the annual capacity of Şişecam's energy glass processing line will expand from 20 million square meters to 26.6 million square meters.

At the same time, Şişecam is moving forward with its glass packaging investment in Eskişehir as well as its flat glass investments for the auto glass and architectural glass business segments. Our Eskişehir glass packaging furnace investment and our auto glass furnace investments in Lüleburgaz are scheduled to go online during the first half of 2023.

In 2022, the world's leading financial institutions reaffirmed their confidence in Şişecam despite the financial market volatility and a general environment of mistrust. This was a significant development for us. In November, we utilized a new syndicated loan worth EUR 240 million from a consortium led by Bank of America and BNP Paribas. With this new credit facility, we aimed to refinance the EUR 175 million syndication loan with a fixed 3-year term obtained in 2019 to meet our investment and working capital needs in Türkiye and Europe. The refinancing deal once again demonstrated Şişecam's solid reputation among international financial institutions.

Sustainability is a key focus of Şişecam… Every decision we make and every step we take is guided by our strategic focus on sustainability. At Şişecam, sustainability also shapes our investments, all our work processes, our corporate culture, and our human resources policies. We are moving forward on our growth journey without compromising our inclusive approach. We prioritize value creation across our entire ecosystem without leaving a single stakeholder behind. From day one, Şişecam has firmly believed that growth and development is only sustainable as long as it is inclusive. This is why we strive to ensure that all our business operations meet the needs of our planet, society, and life.

Şişecam has sustainability, science, and technological advancement in its DNA. We work to extend that same DNA across our entire ecosystem. Şişecam has achieved its current success thanks to these guiding concepts and concrete goals since the day of its founding. Our 2030 CareforNext strategy serves our objective of achieving a better world in numerous ways. Knowing the importance that sustainability holds for

<!-- image -->

future generations, we shape all our work processes and policies around it, basing them on solid and concrete, achievable goals. To meet our net-zero target by 2050, we are moving forward in our sustainability journey - which is always centered around science and technology - with the key concepts of 'Protect the Planet,' 'Empower Society,' and 'Transform Life.'

In addition to its various capabilities, glass is a highly unique material that is exceptionally open to technological improvements. Glass paves the way for innovation and shapes the world of tomorrow. A leader in technology, Şişecam blends glass with science using a strong innovative approach. One of the biggest R&amp;D centers in Europe, the halfcentury-old Şişecam Science, Technology and Design Center undertakes advanced projects to leave a better world for future generations. We combine 87 years of experience with our innovative strength to create a wide range of new technologies for a better and more livable world. At Şişecam, we go beyond simple product design to perform modeling and generate simulationaided designs. Şişecam scientists are able to improve the optimal production output and energy efficiency of furnaces. They are designing state-of-the-art furnaces that are a critical part of glass production. With these innovations and technologies, Şişecam is playing a key role in the future of glass. While closely adhering to the path of science, we are paving the way for new sustainable products that offer solutions for and add value to the entire ecosystem. In addition, Şişecam is developing advanced technologies and innovations that focus on efficient production. We are also leveraging our status as a technology leader to form platforms where we can collaborate with our international business partners to design furnaces and production technologies with an innovative and forward-looking approach. With the 'Plant of the Future' model, Şişecam aims to lead the way in collaborations that contribute to the sustainability of the glass industry. Our aim is to use alternative energy sources - such as electricity, hydrogen, and renewables - in line with Şişecam's CareforNext sustainability strategy.

Dear Stakeholders,

As in the past several years, an elevated level of uncertainty is expected to persist, both in Türkiye and globally, in the foreseeable years to come. As a result, predicting the future with any degree of certainty is increasingly difficult. Despite this challenging environment, Şişecam aims to stand out in 2023 with its data-driven decision-making capabilities and rational operations. As always, we plan to embrace an economic and cultural vision that follows in the footsteps of our inspiring founder, the Great Leader Mustafa Kemal Atatürk. We always strive to do better in all our regions of operation, predict every type of financial and operational risk, and quickly respond to opportunities. Şişecam's goal is to impart Atatürk's unique global vision to the next 100 years of the Turkish Republic.

Driven by our production capabilities and commitment to create sustainable value, 2022 was a year in which we effectively managed risks and reached our ambitious goals with many exceptional accomplishments. On behalf of the Şişecam Family, I would like to thank our 24 thousand employees who always keep Şişecam one step ahead of the competition. I also extend my gratitude to all our stakeholders and investors who have supported Şişecam along its successful journey over the past 87 years.

Annual Report 2022

## AN OVERVIEW OF 2022

Industrial production of construction materials, which increased by 4.4% in the first quarter of 2022 and by 2.1% in the second quarter, in the construction sector, one of the main sectors in which flat glass is consumed in Türkiye, continually decreased in the third quarter by 3.3%. Production continued to decline in the last quarter of 2022 as well.

In Europe, there was a 3% increase in the first quarter, followed by a 1% contraction in the second and third quarters, and a stagnant trend in the last quarter.

Building construction activities in Russia in 2022 were similar to the previous year. In India, the sector grew by 9.7% compared to 2021, driven by urbanization projects across the country.

The global market for small and large household appliances in the white goods sector, one of the important sectors of the Turkish economy, showed a moderate performance in the second half of 2022 as it did in the first half. The results of the Covid-19 pandemic are still being felt, with new impacts from the war in Ukraine and inflation. For example, sales of large home appliances in Southeast Asia rose 18% while they fell 8% in China. In Western Europe, there is a consumer purchase restriction. Türkiye, on the other hand, has become the world's second largest production base with 7% of the world's white goods production. In addition, the Turkish white goods sector, with a production capacity of 25 million units, has become an important production hub in the last decade. Türkiye has become the number one country in Europe in the white goods sector. While the Turkish market sold 6.5 million units in domestic sales in 2012, it set a record in the last decade, reaching 24 million units by the end of 2022. White goods companies operating in Türkiye have been making significant investments in R&amp;D. Over the past decade, the increase in energy efficiency of products has reached 65%.

41

## Global brand that adds value to people and the environment

Şişecam undertakes efforts to achieve customer satisfaction, quickly respond to market needs, boost its service level, and implement brand building initiatives on digital platforms.

The global solar energy sector, which was 40 GW in 2010, reached 1,120 GW in 2022. Global installed capacity of solar energy is expected to quadruple by 2030 and exceed 3 thousand GW. For example, the USA, which currently supplies 3% of its energy needs from solar energy, aims to increase this rate to 40% by 2030 and to 45% by 2050. This transformation also accelerates the initiatives of industrial actors to transform their energy consumption into green energy sources and to limit their carbon footprints. More companies are putting renewable energy investment for their self-consumption on their agenda every day. Şişecam aims to increase its installed patterned glass production capacity to 324 thousand tons per year, and its energy glass processing line capacity to 26.6 million square meters per year, with the capacity increase in patterned glass production and processing line in Mersin. Şişecam supports the development of the rapidly growing solar energy sector in Türkiye with this decision, which is the outcome of its sustainability-oriented value-added production strategy.

## ACHIEVEMENTS IN 2022 AND GOALS FOR THE FUTURE

Adapting to rapidly changing market conditions in the face of all the uncertainties in the world, Şişecam meets the demands coming from both distant markets and nearby geographies at the maximum level with an inclusive approach, within the scope of its capacity, with its widespread production network in 14 countries, and continues to move forward successfully towards its goals. In addition to the current growth opportunities, risks and uncertainties in the market also triggered a process that required the updating of Şişecam's current management methods. In this period shaped by rebalancing, Şişecam reviewed its internal processes and completed the year with successful governance. For Şişecam, 2022 was a year in which national and international markets were diversified, the sales volume was increased by establishing new connections while maintaining its existing customer portfolio, and adaptation was improved through renewals with new investments.

<!-- image -->

Despite changing market conditions in 2022, the needs of the sectors to which it provides input were quickly met with customer focus, which is one of Şişecam's priority areas, and accordingly with customer loyalty and total quality management practices that have been in place for many years. Şişecam continued efforts by supporting its vision of being a global company that adds value to people and the environment with projects to achieve customer satisfaction, to quickly respond to market needs, to increase the service level, and to implement brand building initiatives on digital platforms. As a result of these values, key customer management and effective sales and operations planning was achieved, and the balance of production, sales, and inventory was successfully managed. The outputs of the communication that Şişecam establishes with all its stakeholders are evaluated as feedback. Improvement studies were continued by analyzing the feedback received and reflecting the obtained data to the processes.

<!-- image -->

With the declaration of 2022 as the 'International Year of Glass' by the United Nations, the technological, scientific, and economic importance of glass, which has a strategic importance in all areas of life, was discussed while studies on the diversity of usage areas of glass were increased. Şişecam continues to increase its collaboration with its stakeholders at home and abroad and to develop projects that generate social benefits by reviewing its strategic approaches.

By investigating the sustainable role of glass and recycling processes, it focused more on energy saving and sustainable products and discussed new investments in the patterned glass and energy glass sectors. With an investment of about EUR 228 million, the patterned glass furnace with an annual production capacity of 244 thousand tons and the energy glass line with a processing capacity of 26.6 million square meters per year were planned to be put into operation in 2024. Solar energy stands out as the most applicable solution for electricity generation. Şişecam took steps to turn this opportunity that emerged in the sector into value for Türkiye. Thanks to the new furnace and processing line investment, the aim is to meet the needs of the market by responding to the increasing demand in Türkiye.

The assumption is that industry segments will be in different growth trajectories in 2023 and competition will increase accordingly. Due to uncertainties such as high inflation and increasing interest rates, a slowdown is expected in the construction sector, especially in the first half of 2023. In addition, the need for housing in Türkiye due to urban transformation, the increasing need in Europe due to the renovation market, and growth momentum in the US market in residential and nonresidential buildings will continue to positively affect the flat glass industry.

In order to sustain the satisfaction of all customers in the flat glass value chain, efforts are being carried out, and solutions are being developed for expectations in the face of the dynamism of the market.

## NEW INVESTMENTS, NEW CAPACITIES

Şişecam conducts its activities in the field of flat glass with 10 production facilities in six countries and provides inputs to the construction, furniture, energy, and white goods sectors with its expanding product range.

One of the global flat glass brands that feeds innovative approaches with advanced technology, Şişecam is a leading company in its field not only in Türkiye but also worldwide, with its broad product portfolio with high added value and its customer satisfaction-focused approach. Shaping its strategic focus around sustainability, Şişecam is one of the leading players in the sector with its growth investments in varied geographic locations.

Operating in the field of flat glass with eight flat glass lines in four locations in Türkiye, Şişecam continues its investments without slowing down to ensure the continuity and development of the point it has reached today, despite the cyclical uncertainties, the pandemic the effects of which are still being felt, and global recession expectations.

<!-- image -->

In Turkiye, which is identified as the most beneficial investment area due to investment fundamentals, and as an environment with high returns in terms of expectations, the foundations of Auto Glass Float, a first in its field as it will serve only the automotive sector, were laid in Kırklareli in May 2022 and is planned to be commissioned in 2023. In addition, in December 2021, construction of the TR9 float line with a capacity of 1,200 tons/day was started in Mersin. With the commissioning of these two lines, Şişecam will operate in Türkiye with 10 flat glass lines.

Having also strengthened its position in the global market by expanding its high value-added and innovative product range, Şişecam aims to close the supply gap expected to occur in the energy glass sector by increasing the installed patterned glass production capacity to 324 thousand tons per year with the capacity increase of the patterned glass and processing line to be implemented in Mersin adhering to the principles of Industry 4.0 and by increasing its energy glass processing line capacity to 26.6 million square meters per year. It also aims to contribute to the country's economy by making use of export opportunities.

Şişecam evaluates collaboration opportunities with research institutions, universities, and various start-up companies and aims to enrich its value-added and sustainable product range with its organic and inorganic investments.

## ENERGY AND RAW MATERIAL SAVINGS

## 17.3%

With the project to produce an ultra-light mineral water bottle with a weight of 110g, Şişecam recorded a 17.3% savings in energy and raw material consumption.

Şişecam operates in line with its vision to become a global glass packaging manufacturer that adds value to people and the environment. Toward these ends, Şişecam has received 77 awards, including 18 presented by organizations outside Türkiye, since 2006. As the creator of so many award-winning designs, Şişecam Science, Technology and Design Center is committed to adding new ones to its collection of innovative, high-quality and user-friendly designs.

## 110g Ultra-Light Mineral Water Bottle Project

In the market, average 20cl mineral water bottles are produced with 130-135g weights. The aim of this project is to reduce these weights and encourage the use of standard products, while lowering the amount of raw materials and energy consumed. The accomplishments of the project to produce an ultra-light mineral water bottle with a weight of 110g are as follows:

-  17.3% savings in energy and raw material,
-  19% reduction in productioninduced carbon dioxide emissions,
-  14% reduction in carbon dioxide emissions due to transfer,
-  Logistics cost advantage due to a reduction in pallet inner number (~50 per year).

The bottle design was shaped by analysis studies and the experience of our technical teams.

Produced by reducing the use of energy and natural resources with a sustainability vision, Türkiye's lightest mineral water bottle was introduced to consumers and mineral water producers.

In line with efforts to raise consumer awareness on glass packaging, the Şişecam continued to share a wide range of glass-related content under the topics of environment, health, life, and taste through its social media channel.

Şişecam Glass Packaging participated in the 27 th  Eurasia Packaging Fair organized at TUYAP Fair Convention and Congress Center between November 12-15, 2022. At the fair, Şişecam informed visitors about safe packaging, the characteristics of glass packaging, glass packaging production methods, and glass packaging products developed with innovative technologies, and exhibited its wide product portfolio for various industries from food to pharmaceuticals.

## AN OVERVIEW OF 2022

In the first half of 2022, in the sectors in which Şişecam Chemicals operates, a recovery was experienced due to rebounding demand after the pandemic. Şişecam Chemicals exported soda ash, chrome and Oxyvit products to more than 100 countries in 2022.

## Developments in the Soda Ash Sector

The Russian-Ukrainian war, which started in the first quarter of the year, had an impact on the economy and trade worldwide and in Europe in the form of cost increases and supply shortages throughout the year. This situation manifested as disruptions in energy and food supply, increases in commodity, energy, and agricultural product prices, while demand for soda ash products remained strong during this period.

When evaluating 2022 on a sector basis, the flat glass sector began the year with intense soda ash demand, parallel to the strong course of construction and automotive demand. The demand established solar glass production capacities in India and China. Soda demand of customers in the glass packaging industry also maintained its strong course during the year.

Demand of the detergent sector, where soda ash products are used, maintained its balanced course throughout the year, despite a slight slowdown in demand in the last quarter of the year.

New investments of the lithium sector, especially concentrated in South America, further boosted demand for soda ash.

The increase in global soda ash demand in 2022 was above the level of 2% compared to the previous year.

The reflection of the developments experienced in 2022 showed a similar course in Türkiye as well, as it did on a global scale.

Uncertainties experienced globally from the second quarter, rising energy costs, and supply issues raised product prices. However, despite these increase in the sector continues, especially with the newly developments, the vitality in almost all sectors continued with the impact of exports. Despite the increasing economic uncertainties, the strong demand of exports kept the sectors alive until the third quarter of 2022. Strong demand created a positive impact in demand of the glass, detergent, chemical, and textile industries, where soda ash and sodium bicarbonate are used as inputs. The last quarter of the year witnessed intense competition compared to the third quarter.

## Developments in the Chromium Chemicals Sector

With the impact of the postpandemic recovery, the first half of 2022 started with strong demand in Türkiye and global markets. High inflation and a global economic slowdown, which arose especially in the second half of the year, directly affected the leather sector, where basic chromium sulfate is used as the main input, and caused a global demand contraction. Disruptions in the supply of semiconductor microchips during the year caused production halts in the automotive industry. The metal surface finishing and leather production sectors, which serve the automotive and construction sectors, were adversely affected by these halts. Due to the Zero-Covid policies implemented in China, one of the largest markets of the leather industry, many leather manufacturers shut down. This situation adversely affected the local manufacturers in different countries that provide input to leather production in China, as well as sales to China. Despite the negative developments experienced, Şişecam's sales revenues for chrome chemicals increased during the year.

## ACHIEVEMENTS IN 2022

In 2022, the energy supply problem, increasing production and raw material costs, and high inflation also affected the sectors that use soda products as input and caused demand fluctuations. Managing risks and opportunities correctly in changing market conditions and formulating its strategies in line with current competitive conditions, Şişecam delivered 4.9 million tons of soda ash produced at four facilities located in Türkiye, Europe, and the United States to more than 200 customers in 83 countries. In a challenging global trade environment, service quality was prioritized in line with Şişecam's customer satisfactionoriented service approach. Despite the variable market conditions throughout the year, the desired targets were achieved with adaptive strategies, long-term customer relationships, and agile feedback.

Compared to international competitors, Şişecam Chemicals' soda ash production facilities are differentiated with their abundant supply of raw materials, effective energy management, high production quality and exceptional operational efficiency. ## Şişecam Chemicals

Cromital S.p.A., Şişecam Chemicals' subsidiary in Italy, manufactures and sells BCS in liquid and powder form. It is the market leader in Italy, Europe's biggest leather processing center. Cromital S.p.A. is the only factory in Italy authorized to treat and recover chromium from effluent water generated by the metal plating industry. ## OXYVIT

Oxyvit Kimya - founded jointly with the Italian Cheminvest B.V. in 1996 and wholly acquired in 2017 produces Vitamin K3 and sodium metabisulfite. As Europe's only Vitamin K3 producer, Oxyvit Kimya is positioned as a major supplier in the world feed industry with this high value-added product. The products of Oxyvit, whose sodium metabisulfite product is used in the food, mining, textile, and water treatment sectors, are preferred for their high quality.

Oxyvit maintained its strong position in the market in 2022, generating 76% of its sales revenues from global sales to about 100 customers in 31 countries.

Despite the fluctuations experienced by the feed sector throughout the year, with the quality product supply and customer-oriented approach, Vitamin K3 sales revenue increased by 59% compared to the previous year on a USD basis.

The intense competition in sodium metabisulfite continued in 2022 as well. Developments in the market were followed closely, and supportive relations were maintained with business partners. Oxyvit exported approximately 65% of its sodium metabisulfite production.

## MINING COMPANIES

Mining companies operating to meet the raw material needs of glass, glass fiber and soda factories conduct their business operations as Camiş Madencilik A.Ş. in Türkiye, Camiş Egypt Mining Co. in Egypt and R.K. Vijenac d.o.o. in Bosnia &amp; Herzegovina.

Mining companies with a total of 650 employees worldwide meet the raw material needs of Şişecam, and also provide raw materials to a wide range of manufacturers such as glass, ceramics, cement and silicate outside the company. In 2022, over 500 thousand tons of industrial raw materials were sold by Camiş Madencilik to external customers, 51% of which were outside of Türkiye.

Camiş Madencilik has become a reliable raw material supplier for the industry with its product sales to ceramic and glass manufacturers in Europe and the Middle East for more than 10 years. For the feldspar mineral, product qualifications and the policy of sales outside the Group were updated in 2022, giving priority to domestic demand, aiming to extend the life of the resources under the responsibility of the company and ensure the sustainability of raw materials. Additional reserve development studies are underway in order to boost sales outside the Group.

After the merger of the Group companies Camiş Madencilik A.Ş. and Madencilik San. ve Tic. A.Ş., which was completed in 2021, the transfer procedures of the legal permits of 10 mining sites, which were transferred to Camiş Madencilik A.Ş., were also completed in 2022.

## ŞİŞECAM ELYAF

In early 2019, Şişecam Elyaf commissioned its glass fiber plant equipped with state-ofthe-art technologies. The facility was assessed by the Ministry of Economy, General Directorate of Incentive Implementation and Foreign Investment as a 'Strategic Investment,' and aims to grow in parallel with the developing composite industry.

Şişecam Elyaf manufactures the main inputs for the composite industry, including mats, multi-end roving, single end roving, and chopped strands. A wide range of business sectors are supplied for use in wind turbine blades, interior/exterior automotive parts, engineering plastics, marine products, industrial applications and construction.

The company adapted to the changes in the supply/demand balance in 2021 and took actions to protect business relations in focus markets. The supply/demand imbalance, which continued in 2022, was managed with strong collaborations in the focus markets. Sales volumes were adversely affected due to the contraction of the global market in the last quarter of the year and the drop in freight prices for imported competitor products to pre-pandemic levels.

<!-- image -->

In Türkiye, on the other hand, antidumping implementation for Chinese origin products continues to protect the local manufacturer and the industry. As of 2022, the continuation of the implementation was ensured.

Developments in the wind energy sector in Türkiye and target European markets were monitored during the year. Business relationships have been established with industry leading companies. Demands in this strategically important sector are expected to increase compared to other sectors.

Concurrent to its ongoing marketing activities, Şişecam Elyaf also accelerated its international certification efforts with the aim of being recognized and included in customer supplier portfolios. Aiming to satisfy the needs of target industries in Türkiye and globally, Şişecam fiber products hold DNV-GL, Lloyds Register, FDA (USA), FC (EU 10/2011), KTW and ACS certifications, all of which are internationally recognized.

<!-- image -->

Şişecam Elyaf conducts R&amp;D activities in line with its strategic targets and objectives. R&amp;D efforts are focused on improving existing processes, boosting efficiency and developing high-performance products. To this end, various R&amp;D activities are underway to expand the portfolio with new products by reviewing glass composition, process conditions and final product performance. In parallel with the changing expectations for new products within the current dynamic structure of the composites industry, efforts to expand the existing product portfolio were also accelerated.

In the automotive industry, light vehicle production has gained importance in line with the zerocarbon emission target. For this reason, the use of glass fiber and other composite materials is increasing, taking share from substitute materials.

Şişecam Elyaf maintained its membership with the 'Turkish Composite Industrialists Association' and the 'Association of Energy Industrialists and Businessmen' in 2022. Additionally, the company also joined the Turkish Wind Energy Association as a Member.

## AN OVERVIEW OF 2022

In 2022, the energy crisis caused by the Russia-Ukraine war had a negative impact on the automotive industry, like all sectors of the global economy. Unlike oil crises of the past, this crisis caused disruption in production processes around the world due to its dominance in all energy fields such as natural gas and electricity. European countries, which are dependent on Russia for energy, sought solutions against the risk of recession. Many automotive sector manufacturers operating especially in Europe and Russia experienced temporary or permanent shutdowns due to the contraction in raw material supply and the difficulty in accessing production factors. During this challenging time, manufacturers turned to alternative energy sources and suppliers and tried to overcome the crisis with minimal losses.

Disruptions in the supply chain caused by the chip crisis, which started in 2019 and continued to have an impact in 2022, combined with the threat of recession caused by the energy crisis in Europe, increased the pressure on the global automotive industry. During this period, only those companies that were able to anticipate the potential risks in the sector, assess the situation correctly, and take quick and effective decisions were able to survive.

Global automotive production increased by 6.7% in 2022 compared to the previous year. The geographies of North America and Asia-Pacific played a key role in this increase.

## ACHIEVEMENTS IN 2022

Acting with the vision of becoming a global leader, Şişecam Automotive met all the needs and expectations of its customers in 2022 with its high quality and safe products, thanks to its R&amp;D capabilities open to development and innovation. Şişecam developed its product portfolio by adopting a customer-oriented approach and maintained its sales volume in automotive glass with its high sales performance in Automotive Renewal Glass (ARG) in the USA, Europe, Türkiye and Russia markets, despite the global crisis.

Revenue increased by 110% in foreign currency in 2022 thanks to newly developed products in the automotive renewal glass business line, which was introduced in 2019. In the same period, the number of customers doubled while business development efforts in new geographies accelerated. Adopting the approach of managing risks effectively with a data-driven approach, Şişecam evaluated the risks and opportunities that arose according to the conditions of the day in line with its longterm strategies, rather than making short-term decisions, and ensured optimization at all stages of the value chain despite the fluctuations experienced in the global automotive industry. In 2022, Şişecam's focus was on instantaneous monitoring of disruptions in the supply chain, management of highly increasing costs in a way that does not hinder the sustainability of production, a focus on product development efforts, and optimizing production fluctuations by adapting quickly to changes through simplifying quality activities.

## The right solutions for different needs

In 2022, Şişecam initiated energy-generating glass studies for electric vehicles and produced prototypes with different technologies.

In 2022, Şişecam Automotive focused on and made significant progress in integrating quality control systems, customizing automation practices, boosting employee productivity, and fulfilling its sustainability responsibilities.

## PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

Offering the right solutions for different needs, Şişecam has developed and started mass production of HUD windshields in automotive glass. Work is ongoing on more advanced technological solutions that combine HUD and heating without coating. In line with the goal of expanding the portfolio, innovative studies are underway for roof glasses with adjustable light transmittance. Innovative and customized solutions are currently offered to upper segment vehicles in line with their innovation requirements.

Energy-generating glass studies for electric vehicles were initiated and prototypes with different technologies were produced. Action was taken to produce automotive glasses that can meet the specific demands of autonomous driving technology.

In addition to studies to develop antenna printing and high optical quality technology, breakthroughs were also made in bulletproof glasses.

Şişecam Automotive, which is capable of rapid product development, initiated studies on new technologies that can provide an alternative to screen printing systems in order to make glass production processes leaner and faster.

## DIGITALIZATION

As part of Şişecam's digital transformation journey, Şişecam Automotive focused on the transformation of its production facilities and management centers in seven countries. Input was provided for the development of digital tools used to ensure a common working culture, as well as to simplify and improve business processes.

Having realized most of its digital transformation targets in 2022, Şişecam focused on digital statistical process control applications in its production processes. Applications were introduced where input parameters are constantly monitored and their effects on the product are secured with digital systems.

## Corporate Governance and Compliance Activities at Şişecam

Appropriate and effective processes are designed to implement the best practices in corporate governance within Şişecam. Corporate governance practices are coordinated to include more than 50 subsidiaries to ensure that this key function is carried out in a uniform manner across the Group.

Preparation, administration, and follow-up work for meetings of the Şişecam Board of Directors and its committees are conducted regularly. Sufficient communication between the Şişecam Board of Directors, Board Committees, and the Boards of Directors of subsidiaries is ensured as part of these activities. Coordination of the decision-making process of the Board of Directors of Şişecam and its subsidiaries is performed from a single point. In 2022, Şişecam started using the information system e-YKS (Electronic Board of Directors System), a platform developed by the Central Registry Agency where board meetings in Türkiye can be held legally in an electronic environment.

Authorization procedures in all Şişecam subsidiaries are monitored in line with the articles of association of the relevant companies and in accordance with legal and regulatory requirements. Electronic records of these procedures are kept up to date.

To ensure the creation of a corporate memory, Şişecam systematically and electronically manages all correspondence related to the Board of Directors, committees reporting to the Board, and the chairmanship of the Board. The Board of Directors is regularly informed by the monitoring of strategic and operational issues, as directed by the Board.

The Şişecam Periodic Revision Corporate Governance Rating Report - prepared by SAHA Corporate Governance and Credit Rating Services, a corporate governance rating agency that is also licensed to conduct corporate governance rating activities in Türkiye - has been completed.

Şişecam's Corporate Governance Rating Score improved from 9.55 on December 16, 2021 to 9.60 on December 16, 2022. The category distribution of Şişecam's corporate governance rating is as follows:

## Ethics, Compliance and Regulatory Activities at Şişecam

Şişecam's basic corporate principles and values emphasize topics related to ethics and compliance. Meanwhile, the company's new investments and an expanding geographic footprint require compliance with numerous and diverse local and international regulations. The goal is to move Şişecam forward into the future with an inclusive system in which all values are internalized.

Regulatory and compliance activities include administering holistic and centralized compliance efforts across the Group, formulating strategies in accordance with best practices as well as internal and external legislation, and ensuring coordination as needed.

<!-- image -->

Şişecam established a compliance governance system with a risk-based approach. Control points and internal legislation are managed with a dynamic approach in line with current developments.

Centralized compliance structure studies at Şişecam are based on contemporary practices. Establishment of a systematic infrastructure based on international best practices was completed at T. Şişe ve Cam Fabrikaları A.Ş. This effort included identifying compliance risk factors and developing a compliance risk assessment methodology. Risks and actions can be monitored through the system. Tasks can be assigned to relevant parties for improvement areas. This infrastructure enables reporting to allow monitoring of compliance actions according to various criteria. In effect, Şişecam set up a dynamic compliance structure that can be monitored.

Legal and regulatory compliance is a cornerstone of Şişecam's operations. In addition to previously published policies on ethics and compliance issues such as Anti-Bribery and AntiCorruption, Gift and Hospitality, and Donation, in 2022, Şişecam prepared and enacted policies related to AntiRetaliation, Human Rights, and AntiMoney Laundering, and Combating the Financing of Terrorism and Sanctions. All compliance regulations (including the Code of Ethics), all internal regulations and policies available in the languages of all countries in which Şişecam operates are reviewed for compliance with corporate structure and regulations.

Compliance with legislation in all countries where Şişecam operates is taken into consideration. Comprehensive integration of compliance activities to cover 14 countries is ongoing. The Group's internal rules and regulations are kept up to date. Areas for improvement are continuously monitored in line with international best practices.

As part of efforts to expand the ethics and compliance culture at the company, Şişecam reorganized the mandatory annual business ethics training on the Code of Ethics. This training started to be provided to employees in four languages in 2022. To raise awareness of international sanctions, informational activities for relevant employees are underway.

Under the Gift and Hospitality Policy, Şişecam established an online notification system for gifts received and given. Internal and external stakeholders are regularly informed about the relevant policies.

Şişecam's Code of Ethics, which forms the basis of Şişecam's business conduct, and other compliance regulations supporting these rules are available on the corporate website. Violations of these binding principles can be reported via the Şişecam Ethics Hotline, which is also accessible on the website.

Şişecam designed its notification system to foster a compliance culture. At the start of 2022, the Şişecam Ethics Hotline was restructured in accordance with international regulations and is now available in 17 languages. The system, accessible both online and via telephone, was developed by an independent service provider to receive anonymous notifications.

As part of efforts to ensure transparent information flow, compliance-related information requests and questions received by Şişecam from all parties are evaluated and responded to together with the Legal Department.

The Corporate Governance Committee is periodically informed about all compliance activities. Ethics and compliance-related notifications are evaluated by the Ethics Committee.

## Risk Management and Internal Audit Activities

Şişecam, operating on an international scale across an extensive geographic area, implements effective risk management and internal audit processes to provide adequate risk assurance to its stakeholders. The company constantly reviews and improves its risk management and internal audit processes to respond to evolving needs.

The year 2022 brought a series of crises and numerous risks to the forefront in addition to various uncertainties from the prior period. The Russia-Ukraine war and its aftermath was undoubtedly the most important risk topic of the year. This tumultuous environment included growth expectations that were revised downward, an energy crisis that rocked Europe, elevated inflation that became a chronic problem globally, higher costs across the board, ongoing supply chain problems, rising cyber risks, and natural disasters caused by climate change - all at once. Risks became more pronounced, worsening the overall socio-economic outlook and expectations. The coming year presents a high risk outlook with many potential threats.

A significant portion of these risks, which happened rapidly and need to be managed with a proactive perspective, are uninsurable. This fact has strengthened the perception of risk across the world. As a result, the importance and added value of assurance functions such as risk management and internal audit have grown even more as critical corporate governance disciplines. This volatile environment requires a highly effective approach to monitoring and responding to risks that are constantly increasing, changing, and proliferating to ensure sustainability of operations.

To this end, Şişecam continuously improves the effectiveness of its risk management and internal audit activities - two key functions of corporate governance. The company benefits from the synergy created by the coordinated management of these important functions. Risk management activities are conducted under the Early Detection of Risk Committee. Internal audit activities are carried out under the Audit Committee. Both committees are organized as subcommittees of the Board of Directors. The outcomes of regular meetings held with these committees are reported to the Board of Directors. These

<!-- image -->

activities are aimed at providing necessary assurance to stakeholders; protecting Şişecam's tangible and intangible assets, resources, and the environment; minimizing losses arising from uncertainties; and maximizing benefits from potential opportunities.

## Risk Management at Şişecam

Şişecam is committed to improving the effectiveness of its risk management processes. This year, the company focused especially on raising the risk assurance provided to stakeholders in the intensely competitive environment and effectively managing ever-expanding uncertainties caused by global developments.

At Şişecam, risk management activities are conducted with a holistic approach based on enterprise risk management principles. Activities carried out in line with the company's objectives and strategies are constantly reviewed and improved, taking into account best practices. Digitalization and technological infrastructure opportunities are utilized to facilitate risk management activities. Monitoring and reporting mechanisms are in place to ensure healthy functioning of risk management processes.

<!-- image -->

As part of risk management activities, Şişecam monitors key risk indicators related to operations, assesses and prioritizes exposure to risks, and monitors risks linked to action plans. All financial and non-financial risk factors that may have a negative impact on company operations are regularly analyzed. In addition, all assessments made are periodically reported. To this end, effective communication and coordination is carried out with all relevant functions across Şişecam.

## Internal Audit at Şişecam

At Şişecam, internal audit activities are performed globally across the Group. These activities are designed to support the healthy development of the company's functions and ensure uniformity in practices. Internal audit efforts at the company also aim to guarantee that all activities are performed in compliance with applicable laws and regulations and that corrective actions are executed in a timely manner. Internal audit activities aim to contribute to Şişecam's business efficiency by conducting studies to make processes more effective. Audit programs are prepared with a risk-oriented perspective and implemented using a technology infrastructure and tools supported by data analytics.

Digital transformation has accelerated considerably due to technological breakthroughs and crises in various fields in recent years globally. Within this transformation, audit activities became more accurate and reliable with the use of data analytics, development of continuous monitoring mechanisms, robotic process automation, artificial intelligence, and dynamic risk management methods.

In parallel with these global developments, Şişecam has adopted an internal audit and risk management approach that adapts to its functional organizational structure and capitalizes on opportunities provided by digital transformation. This new approach embraces a way of doing business that is subjectbased, risk-oriented, IT-based, preventive and guiding, while also utilizing effective detection and action tracking mechanisms.

## Sustainability

## Operations centered around sustainability

At Şişecam, sustainability is the focal point of the company's operations and a fundamental component of the business model.

## CareforNext 2030 Sustainability Strategy

At Şişecam, sustainability is the focal point of the company's operations and a fundamental component of the business model. Investments, products, and process development activities are planned and executed in parallel with Şişecam's CareforNext Sustainability Approach. Risks related to key processes affecting business operations are assessed with a holistic risk approach that includes the CareforNext approach. This sustainability-based strategic approach is integrated into Şişecam's general business strategy. CareforNext is based on the main axes of creating long-term value, protecting natural resources, investing in people, and monitoring technological innovations. In addition, CareforNext is integrated with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and aims to create positive impact and value on a global scale with its strong goals, innovative practices, and solutions. CareforNext is an important guide shaped by dynamic assessments focused on an environmental, social, and governance (ESG) framework. Şişecam aims to broaden its CareforNext Sustainability Approach to include all stakeholders throughout the value chain - from raw material procurement to postconsumer recovery.

Formulated in line with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, Şişecam's sustainability roadmap is the CareforNext Strategy. With this forward-looking strategy, Şişecam aims to be a leading organization that creates positive impact and value on a global scale with solutions and services that Protect the Planet, Empower Society, and Transform Life. While developing this strategy, Şişecam considered its value chain, as well as the needs and expectations of all stakeholders in this chain, with a long-term perspective. After performing a prioritization analysis with broad stakeholder participation, Şişecam used the outputs in 2021 to identify three main axes in the CareforNext strategy developed to target these focus areas. CareforNext was positioned on three main axes covering 11 priority Environmental, Social, and Governance topics, and supported by clear and concrete objectives. Under the three main axes - 'Protect the Planet,' 'Empower Society' and 'Transform Life' - of the strategy, Şişecam set and publicly disclosed targets that are planned to be achieved by 2030.

Şişecam aims to expand its CareforNext Sustainability Approach to include all stakeholders in every aspect of its value chain.

Şişecam's prioritized issues are Climate Change, Water Use, and Circular Production under the 'Protect The Planet' axis; Corporate Heritage, Equality, Diversity and Inclusion, Talent Acquisition, Development, and Management, as well as Occupational Health and Safety under the 'Empower Society' axis; and Sustainability in the Value Chain, Digitalized Value Chain, Sustainable Products, and ValueAdding Collaborations under the 'Transform Life' axis.

## Sustainability Governance

Şişecam strengthened its sustainability governance structure to ensure that the CareforNext Sustainability Strategy, which is integrated with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, is adopted and managed effectively at all functions and levels of the organization.

To this end, Şişecam established the Board of Directors Sustainability Committee to fully integrate sustainability into the company's structure, and to set and coordinate sustainability policies at the company. The Committee is structured at the Board of Directors level under the leadership of Şişecam's Chairman. With this governance structure, Şişecam ensures the adoption, effective monitoring, and management of the CareforNext

Sustainability Strategy at all functions and levels of the organization by the highest authority at the company.

The strategic direction of the Board of Directors Sustainability Committee is reflected in Şişecam's operations through the Sustainability Executive Committee. The Sustainability Executive Committee is chaired by the CEO and consists of members of the Executive Board. The Committee carries out the vision, priority and strategy development efforts in this area, internal and external stakeholder communications, and the sustainability targets and performance monitoring of the working groups. The Committee evaluates developments related to the studies and objectives of its working groups.

In 2022, Şişecam established themebased Sustainability Working Groups reporting to the Committee under CareforNext's three main axes 'Protect the Planet,' 'Empower Society,' and 'Transform Life' and including managers from all functional areas of the company. With this governance structure, CareforNext's Sustainability Strategy is supported at all functions and levels of the organization, from senior management to the production facilities. A sustainability scorecard was created by adding the actions planned to conduct sustainability studies on prioritized issues in line with our 2030 goals and achieve their targets to the scorecards of senior managers across all functions.

By directing and monitoring the CareforNext strategy from the highest point of the organization, Şişecam ensures that the sustainability approach is adopted

Since its founding, Şişecam has stood out with its ethical values, transparency, management accountability, and responsible approach towards its stakeholders.
