## Sustainability Performance and Communication

The Sustainability Directorate is responsible for developing and expanding the corporate sustainability strategy, reporting and communicating the corporate sustainability performance, and measuring in-house sustainability studies.

Since its founding, Şişecam has remained committed to ethical values, transparency, accountability and taking a responsible approach to its stakeholders. Şişecam was once again included in the BIST Sustainability Index for the period of January-December 2022 under the name Türkiye Şişe ve Cam Fabrikaları A.Ş. (SISE), following a review of companies trading on Borsa Istanbul (BIST). As a result of the comprehensive evaluation made by Refinitiv, which is used to determine inclusion in the BIST Sustainability Index, Şişecam's score was raised to A-. Şişecam's ESG performance is above average in national and international sustainability indices and assessments.

Since 2011, Şişecam has regularly monitored carbon emissions from its business operations. Data obtained from its monitoring efforts are disclosed via the Carbon Disclosure Project (CDP) Climate Change and Supply Chain program. In 2022, Şişecam publicly disclosed its report on the previous year's carbon emissions performance of the Group's operations in Türkiye, Italy and Bulgaria. The report included details of Şişecam's risk and opportunities analyses in accordance with the principle of transparency. In addition, Şişecam shared information on product and production-based carbon emissions with its CDP customers.

As a global player with 45 production facilities located in 14 countries, Şişecam assesses the risks and opportunities of climate change in production and operational processes with a holistic perspective. As part of efforts to transition to a lowcarbon economy, Şişecam develops action plans to align its climatefocused governance, strategy, risk management, targets, and metrics with the TCFD (Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures) framework.

Sustainability reports describe the sustainability approach of Şişecam and its subsidiaries. These reports include economic, environmental and social indicators and assess the performance of the company's production activities within this context. Şişecam's sustainability reports are drawn up according to GRI (Global Reporting Initiative) standards and are accessible to all its stakeholders. Şişecam's sustainability reports cover all operating regions. The reports are also available in audio book versions in English and Turkish on the relevant pages of the corporate website. Financial indicators in the 2022 Şişecam Sustainability Report were confirmed by the Annual Report. This year, Şişecam initiated efforts to verify its environmental and social indicators as well. The verification statement and verified data will be published in the 2022 Sustainability Report.

https://www.sisecam.com.tr/en/ sustainability/reporting/sustainabilityreport

## New investments in line with Şişecam's sustainability vision

Scenario-based studies on a low-carbon roadmap are initiated to serve Şişecam's carbon-neutral vision.

Şişecam launched the Sustainability Micro-website (https://sustainability. sisecam.com/en), which includes information about the Şişecam CareforNext Sustainability Approach, goals, and actions, online with different language options.

During the year, Şişecam participated in many public panels, seminars and sector association events. The company provided support, such as reporting training, at these various events. Şişecam participated as a speaker on the ISO Moving Forward for Industrial Sustainability panel, a side event of the COP27 UN Climate Summit held in Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt on November 7-18, 2022. At this panel discussion, Şişecam representatives explained the company's CareforNext Sustainability Strategy and goals under the headings of 'Protect the Planet,' 'Empower Society,' and 'Transform Life.'

CareforNext - Protect the Planet Under the 'Protect the Planet' axis, Şişecam carries out projects designed to minimize the impacts of Climate Change, reduce Water Use, and support Circular Production. Collaborations and joint studies are undertaken to achieve these goals. To these ends, activities are ongoing in the areas of reducing energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions, as well as water management and the renewable energy use. Şişecam is making good progress with its priorities of Climate Change, Water Use, and Circular Production.

Şişecam approaches the global problem of climate change with great sensitivity. The company has taken major steps to mitigate the impact of its operations on the environment, especially in terms of energy conservation. Şişecam furnaces are among the most efficient in the industry, especially in comparison to glass production in EU countries. The company has recorded significant progress thanks to its efforts related to energy efficiency, recovery of energy loss, and the application of best available techniques (BAT) to reduce its energy needs.

In line with its 2050 carbon-neutral vision, Şişecam initiated numerous efforts to achieve its goals this year. Scenario-based studies on a lowcarbon roadmap and processes to design electric furnaces that will enable low- or zero-carbon melting, R&amp;D studies on alternative raw materials and shaping renewable energy investments to support clean energy transformation are underway. Energy-intensive operational processes are holistically strengthened with energy efficiency studies with a focus on sustainability. Investment plans are moving forward in line with the company's sustainability vision. In 2022, Şişecam executed over 350 environmental and energy-oriented project investments totaling more than USD 17 million under its sustainability action plan.

Şişecam aims to expand its renewable energy generation capacity by eight times to support its clean energy transformation. The company plans to reach an installed renewable energy generation capacity of 53 MWp, mainly for electricity consumption at its factories. Wind and solar energy investments for renewable electricity are planned. In addition to the solar energy panels commissioned at company site locations in northern and southern Italy, Şişecam plans to install rooftop solar energy systems

<!-- image -->

in 2023 at the Ankara Flat Glass and Eskişehir Glass Packaging factories. A total of 10 MWp installed capacity is planned in the first phase with rooftop solar power generation plants at the Mersin Flat Glass plant and the Şişecam Science, Technology and Design Center.

As part of preparatory work, Şişecam completed studies on current due diligence and identification of deficiencies to establish sciencebased targets in line with the SBTi methodology, among its 2030 targets. Development of a technological roadmap is planned for the decarbonization of Şişecam's production and value chain. The strategic plan includes the transition to electric furnace technologies, where electricity is used in the glass melting process, and investments that enable greater utilization of green electricity in energy-intensive processes. Use of this advanced technology is expected to reduce glass melting emissions by up to 70%.

Şişecam's energy transformation activities include conducting evaluation and pre-feasibility studies to utilize renewable energy at its facilities. The company initiated efforts to determine optimal roof designs and static suitability of its buildings. Investments will be prioritized and realized in line with financial feasibility. In projects developed for wind and solar energy use at priority facilities, Şişecam completed calculation and technical guidance studies. These projects were included among the company's 2022 investments.

Şişecam aims to create a positive impact in the usage phase with sustainable and energy-efficient products. The company also conducts efforts to lower carbon emissions in its production processes. Targeting less raw material use and lower energy consumption in glass packaging designs, Şişecam achieved a 15% greenhouse gas emission reduction in a single bottle type with lightweight glass packaging solutions. Efforts are underway to develop other climate-friendly and sustainable innovations to products in its current portfolio. These include architectural glass that saves energy via heat and solar control, lightweight auto glass, photovoltaic panel glass, glass fiber that provides input to wind turbines, glass packaging produced using high glass cullet, and 100% recycled glassware.

Company-wide efforts to manage resources using an integrated waste management, sustainability in the supply chain, and circular economy approach are ongoing. Şişecam maintains its life-cycle-oriented approach in the value chain in line with its CareforNext Sustainability Strategy. An online waste monitoring application was piloted last year. Şişecam standardized and expanded the scope of this solution for use at the company's soda and chromium facilities. This online application ensures efficient waste sorting and source-based waste monitoring at the production site.

This year, Şişecam once again actively contributed to advisory meetings and studies organized by relevant public authorities to evaluate regulations such as the European Green Deal and the European Union (EU) Carbon Border Tax Mechanism at the national level and helped set sector priorities. These various activities analyzed the potential financial impacts and related risks of the carbon border tax implementation based on production and product group. Assessment studies were also carried out related to opportunities within the existing regulatory framework such as the EU Green Taxonomy, the Transformation Wave in Buildings, and Zero Energy Buildings - which are rapidly gaining importance.

## Circular production practices

Şişecam is aware of the advantageous positions of glass in the circular economy. The company has set a primary goal of introducing a circular model to its business operations, including sustainable use of energy and natural resources.

National efforts are underway to ensure effective implementation of an integrated permitting and monitoring procedure aligned with the EU Industrial Emissions Directive. Şişecam conducted situation assessments for its production lines and provided technical support to project teams under the Determination of Industrial Emission Strategy of Türkiye in Accordance with the Integrated Pollution Prevention and Control project coordinated by the Turkish Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change.

As a leader in the global glass industry, Şişecam is aware of the advantageous position of glass in the circular economy. The company has set a primary goal of introducing a circular model to its business operations, including sustainable use of energy and natural resources. Other activities that support these goals include conducting resource and waste management excellence studies, expanding best practices, reducing clean water demand via industrial symbiotic practices, and building circular business models. These efforts are aimed at expanding Şişecam's circular production practices.

In line with its 2030 Strategy, Şişecam has adopted the target of boosting the proportion of external cullet used in glass packaging production processes up to 35%. In addition to long-term studies carried out on separating glass at its source and increasing the supply of cullet, Şişecam participated in preparatory work of the National Deposit Return System, which is planned to be implemented in Türkiye in 2023. As a leading representative of the sector, Şişecam contributed to the preparation of the legal infrastructure to support glass recycling at the national level. Additional investments required by Şişecam production facilities to reduce emissions via primary operational measures after harmonization with EU regulations were also identified.

At Şişecam, efficient water consumption falls within the scope of its corporate sustainability approach CareforNext. The company implements a wide range of projects and studies to reduce water consumption in all production regions and maximize recovery. The company has adopted a zero discharge target by identifying water saving areas and engaging in awareness raising activities. Efforts to identify the potential of Şişecam facilities and bolster its monitoring infrastructure are ongoing.

Pilot studies have commenced on the system that will provide wastewater recovery and bioenergy with Basalia Bio-Cycle Technology, a key initiative related to Şişecam's 2030 sustainability targets. The Basalia application, scheduled for implementation at Şişecam Mersin soda plant, aims to significantly reduce clean water consumption through the recovery of wastewater.

## CareforNext - Empower Society

Under the 'Empower Society' axis, Şişecam is committed to creating value for all stakeholders, including local people and communities, employees, business partners, customers and consumers, and suppliers. With the impact of the 2022 United Nations International Year of Glass - which recognizes the major significance of glass in adding value to the development of civilizations and human life from past to present - Şişecam supports global efforts to expand glass culture. The company is also implementing corporate social responsibility activities toward this end that support its CareforNext vision.

Şişecam is making progress with the Corporate Heritage, Equality, Diversity and Inclusion, Talent Acquisition, Development and Management, and Occupational Health and Safety priorities under this axis.

<!-- image -->

In 1935, Şişecam was founded in Beykoz Paşabahçe by Türkiye İş Bankası, which undertook the task of industrialization in the field of glass and the establishment and development of the glass industry under Atatürk's directives. Since that time, Şişecam has grown from a domestic glass company into a top global player in glass manufacturing. While moving forward on its journey to sustainable success, Şişecam operates with the aim of preserving and passing on its corporate heritage of glass to future generations.

Şişecam represents the glass industry on international platforms as a pioneer in the sector and plays a leadership role in global organizations. To emphasize the importance of glass, Şişecam collaborated with the International Commission on Glass (ICG) and contributed to the declaration of 2022 as the International Year of Glass (IYOG) by the United Nations General Assembly. This effort was supported by more than 1,500 manufacturers, universities, museums, associations, and artists from 78 countries worldwide. Many events and activities were held throughout 2022 in conjunction with the IYOG.

<!-- image -->

Having integrated equality and diversity in the workplace into its corporate culture, Şişecam sets its goals in this area with its Empower Society vision. Any kind of discrimination based on language, religion, race, nationality, age, sexual orientation, gender, or any other difference is strictly prohibited at Şişecam. The company instead views such differences as a reflection of diversity. To this end, Şişecam conducts awareness-raising activities on equality, diversity, and inclusion. The company takes an inclusive stance in its management and leadership approach, enabling every Şişecam employee to realize their potential. Şişecam aims to spread its inclusive workplace culture across its business operations and expand it to its business partners.

Şişecam evaluates its own workforce for different positions by facilitating internal job mobility. The company recruits new talent as needed while managing and developing its new hires as well as existing employees. In addition, Şişecam organizes the Together and First Step internship programs to introduce young talent to the company and support their participation in employment and preparation for the business world.

One of top priorities at Şişecam is ensuring that employees work under the highest level of health, hygiene and occupational safety conditions in their working environments. Şişecam embraces continuous improvement of the occupational safety conditions of its employees. In-house development and improvement areas are identified. Areas deemed in need of attention are addressed as quickly as possible. In line with the CareforNext 2030 Sustainability Strategy, Şişecam ensures that OHS trainings and policies are adopted by all employees to create the corporate culture needed to achieve the goal of zero accidents and lead a healthy life.

## CareforNext - Transform Life

Under the 'Transform Life' axis, Şişecam focuses on a more digital, more optimized, and more integrated operational excellence approach that creates solutions for the future needs of the planet and society. Şişecam is making progress with the Digitalized Value Chain, Sustainable Products, Sustainability in the Value Chain, and Value Adding Collaborations priorities under this axis. The company is committed to developing products and solutions that will transform lives.

As a part of its digitalized value chain move, Şişecam upgraded its technology infrastructure and expanded its Industry 4.0 applications. Projects are carried out to accurately identify the needs that arise in parallel with developing technologies and offer the most appropriate response to these needs. Şişecam developed mobile applications in the field of architectural glass to support end consumers, architects, industry professionals, and project specialists to access the right information quickly. In 2022, Şişecam also conducted projects aimed at developing a digital working environment, expanding digitalization efforts throughout corporate operations, and fostering data-driven decision-making.

Şişecam focuses on sustainable products with the environmental awareness and responsibility of being a sector leader. To this end, the company aims to increase its patented sustainable products, boost the share of sustainable products in turnover, develop new sustainable solutions and products, and evaluate the impacts of all stages of product life using the life cycle assessment methodology. Glass product solutions that create value for society and the environment are growing in importance in the world's transition to low carbon. In 2022, 54% of Şişecam's total R&amp;D project expenditures were for sustainability projects.

At Şişecam, life cycle assessment is seen as a key tool to expand the company's range of sustainable products as well as a major way to promote sustainability in the product design and production stages. In 2022, Şişecam completed the first phase of a comprehensive product life cycle assessment (LCA) project. With this effort, the company aimed to register sustainable products, seize opportunities based on life cycles, and manage sustainability expectations across the entire value chain. Under the project, LCA analyses were conducted for 16 sustainable products that

<!-- image -->

make a difference especially in Flat Glass, Auto Glass, Glass Packaging, Glassware and Chemicals. Approved and verified Environmental Product Declaration (EPD)s were realized for all flat glass products.

Sustainable supply chain management is a strategic priority at Şişecam that creates value. Efforts to integrate environmental, social and governance (ESG) priorities into all phases of the supply chain, including evaluation, application, monitoring and improvement of supplier management, are underway. As part of this work, Şişecam is conducting a comprehensive process review and including ESG dimensions in the following processes:

-  Supplier Commissioning and Decommissioning Systems
-  Supplier Performance Evaluation Systems
-  Supplier Development Practices
-  Supplier Segmentation Studies
-  Supplier Sustainability Platform
-  General Terms and Conditions of Procurement
-  Şişecam Supplier Code of Conduct
-  Supplier Competency Audit

<!-- image -->

In accordance with the digitalization approach in the supply chain, supplier applications are received via the Şişecam Supplier Portal as of 2018. Suppliers submitting applications on this portal can continue with the process by accepting the Şişecam Supplier Code of Conduct and are informed about their expectations in this regard. The Şişecam Supplier Code of Conduct can also be used in the tender and contract stages. As part of its responsible purchasing approach, Şişecam requires that its suppliers' ways of doing business comply with the Şişecam Supplier Code of Conduct. Whether Şişecam suppliers have policies in place relating to child labor, forced/uninsured employment, compliance with occupational health and safety requirements, gender equality, bullying and harassment or discrimination can be monitored via the Şişecam Supplier Portal. With its new 2030 strategy, Şişecam aims for all its suppliers to comply with the criteria spelled out in the Şişecam Supplier Code of Conduct. By year-end 2022, about 50% of active non-Group suppliers had accepted the Şişecam Supplier Code of Conduct, accounting for 80% of Şişecam's purchasing volume.

The Şişecam Supplier Management Procedure is scheduled to go into effect in the near future. Under this procedure, Şişecam suppliers will be subject to a preliminary assessment based on question lists being prepared related to the aforementioned supplier portal goods/services categories. This procedure will measure supplier performance through surveys or supplier scorecards created from logistics and quality performance data pulled from the system, for categories identified as critical based on the goods/services they supply. As another supplier assessment method, Şişecam conducts supplier audits. These audits are primarily performed within the scope of process/quality audits.

According to the results obtained from the above-referenced methods, supplier development actions are necessary for suppliers that perform below the expected level and/or are deemed to be high risk. The indicated performance level remains the same until an improvement is observed for the relevant supplier. If no improvement is detected, actions such as reducing the supplier's share, deactivating the supplier in question, or finding alternative suppliers are initiated. Through these applications, Şişecam aims to raise supplier awareness on expected quality and sustainability standards and ensure their continuous improvement on these issues.

As part of its sustainable supply chain practices, Şişecam launched the Şişecam Supplier Segmentation project in fourth quarter 2022. This effort was further detailed in various dimensions. Under this project, suppliers are segmented on two main axes - Supplier Risk and Supplier Benefit Potential - by assessing them on a wide range of relevant criteria.

As a result of the assessment of supplier risk and benefit potential criteria, Şişecam aims to manage and develop its supplier portfolio based on the segments identified. Strategic suppliers are also planned to be separated into two more subgroups based on supplier performance and supplier sustainability score results. In response to the segmentation outputs, Şişecam developed specific action sets to be applied to each segment. Implementation and realization of the actions will be monitored on a one-onone basis. At this point, Şişecam aims to carry out supplier management in the most effective way, as the company advances towards its goal of a sustainable supply chain that creates value.

Şişecam's supply chain is a key component of the CareforNext strategy. The company's supply chain is managed holistically with a crisis and risk management approach that includes all suppliers globally, leaving no stakeholder behind. Şişecam is committed to supporting suppliers, who are among the most critical elements of the company's value chain, with capacity building programs. In addition, Şişecam aims to align its suppliers with the CareforNext strategy via its code of conduct policies as a core objective under these efforts.

Şişecam plans to expand its global contact with all its stakeholders, and thereby boost its social, environmental, and economic sustainability impact. Communication outputs are evaluated as feedback via established national and international partnerships and collaborations. Improvement efforts are conducted by reflecting these data on business processes. Projects that serve SDG 17 (Partnerships for the Goals) and generate social benefits are also under development.

## SUPPORT TO CULTURAL VALUES

## Antique Glass Works Collection

The Antique Glass Works Collection, which is protected and exhibited in a specially prepared area at Şişecam Headquarters, is registered with the Istanbul Archeology Museum. The collection consists of 520 archaeological and ethnographic antique glass works acquired by Şişecam to protect cultural values. Items in the collection date back nearly 3,500 years.

Şişecam moved its Antique Glass Works Collection to digital platforms to transfer its cultural heritage to future generations and preserve this valuable heritage in the best possible way. The Antique Glass Works Collection exhibition reflects the historic development of glass through the centuries and is accessible at https://www.sisecamcameserleri. com/tr

Şişecam offers art-lovers the opportunity to view items in the collection under the categories of the Ottomans, the Byzantines, Roman Empire, and Ancient Greece. Select items are viewable in 3D. Online visitors can review each item in terms of its era, region of origin, and technical features used during their production.

## History-Culture-Glass Collections

In line with its mission to preserve and pass on cultural heritage to future generations, Şişecam exhibited the first of the History, Culture and Glass Collections in 1999 in Paşabahçe Stores. These special collections reflected the historic and cultural background of Anatolia through glass artworks.

To date, Şişecam has launched a total of 16 History-Culture-Glass collections: Ottoman, Blue and White on Glass, Artistic Writing on Glass, Enameled Glass, Mosaics, Anatolian Civilizations, Seven, Ashura, Istanbul, Crystalline Chinas, Talking Moneys/ Coins, Zevk-i Selim, World Heritage in Glass, Lost Treasures, and Antique Glass Works. Each collection consists of limited-edition products. This handmade glassware, created in inspiration from the Antique Glass Works Collection by Paşabahçe Stores and reflecting the era of the Roman Empire, was offered to customers as a unique memory from an earlier time and meaningful gift. The Antique Glass Works Collection consists of 520 pieces and describes the historic development of glass from 5 thousand years ago to the present. The collection is accessible on the Şişecam corporate website at https://www.sisecamcameserleri. com/tr

## Forestation

Şişecam designates areas between 5-10 dunams within the sites of its facilities as forest land. Şişecam Forests are also brought to life in all regions where the company operates. In 2000, Camiş Madencilik A.Ş. initiated forestation work in the Yalıköy Region, where the company's pit and facilities are located. Today, Şişecam Forest land in the area has grown to 368 dunams. Forestation work initiated in 2017 on an area of about 32 thousand m 2  around the Karabük Eflani Breaking and Sieving Facility was completed in first quarter 2019.

Rehabilitation work that started in 2021 on an area of about 20 hectares at the Bilecik Facility continued in 2022. The area is planned to be afforested in 2023. Nearly 22 hectares of the parcel with license number RN.1203 in Tekirdağ Safaalanı, abandoned due to the depletion of mineral reserves, was rehabilitated by Camiş Madencilik and delivered to the Forestry Administration for forestation.

Şişecam designates areas between 5-10 dunams within the sites of its facilities as forest land. Şişecam Forests are also brought to life in all regions where the company operates.

Thanks to its sapling planting efforts in the Cankurtaran region, Şişecam Glassware Denizli Plant created a mini forest of 2,920 trees on an area of 3 dunams.

Şişecam Chemicals Mersin Soda and Kromsan Plants commenced planting activities in 2006. The facilities carry out planting efforts every year, identifying treeless zones and planting trees in these areas. The 16 th Tree Planting Festival was realized in 2022 by planting some 1,000 additional saplings with the help of Mersin Provincial Directorate of Forestry due to pandemic conditions. To date, some 48,500 trees have been planted in the 16 years of these efforts.

## Support to recycling awareness

In parallel with Şişecam's sustainability strategy, the Glass and Glass Again project has prevented glass waste equivalent to 10.8 billion glass bottles to date.

## Glass and Glass Again

The Glass and Glass Again project, one of Türkiye's most comprehensive sustainability and social responsibility initiatives, has been carried out by Şişecam since 2011.

This large-scale project is aimed at transitioning to a recycling society while effecting a change in social behavior. To date, Glass and Glass Again has instructed over 250 thousand elementary school students on recycling, provided more than 20 thousand glass recycling bins for use by municipalities, and recycled over 2 million tons of glass waste since its launch in 2011. The initiative has prevented carbon dioxide emissions equivalent to withdrawing 703 thousand cars from the roads for 10 thousand km; achieved energy savings from recycling equivalent to meeting the heating and hot water needs of 82 thousand households for a year; and prevented carbon dioxide emission equivalent to purifying the air with 60 million trees in one year.

In parallel with Şişecam's sustainability strategy, the Glass and Glass Again project has prevented glass waste equivalent to 10.8 billion glass bottles. This popular initiative has reached millions of people with various events and awareness-raising activities. Şişecam continues to raise awareness on the importance of glass recycling with Glass and Glass Again.

## Glass and Glass Again Raises Awareness on Social Media

Social media accounts that draw attention to glass recycling by sharing the importance of recycling, information on the use of glass, and recycling gains with different setups provide access to many people. Reaching a wide target audience via its social media accounts, the Glass and Glass Again project contributes greatly to awareness-raising efforts on this key topic.

## Europe's leading R&amp;D Center

Four new products to use with glass fiber reinforced composite products proceeded to production.

Research and development, design, and quality activities are managed under the Chief Research, Development and Quality Office (R&amp;DQ) in parallel with Şişecam's strategies and by taking into account trends in all sectors. These activities are supported with national and international collaborations.

Şişecam Science, Technology and Design Center includes the most advanced R&amp;D facility in Türkiye, and the leading facility in Europe in the glass industry, 31 well-equipped expert laboratories, and the Design Center, which designs glassware (CEE) and glass packaging (CA). Some 38% of the 253-person research staff, including 40 design professionals, have a postgraduate degree. The R&amp;D Center is supported within the scope of Law No. 5746 Regarding Support to Research, Development and Design Activities. The R&amp;D Center has conducted 35 umbrella projects and the Design Center has conducted seven umbrella projects.

## New Products/Technologies

To respond to the changing climatic conditions of different world regions, Şişecam focuses on developing new low emissivity coated glass products with heat and light control features for architectural applications. This is a key R&amp;D focus at the company area every year. In 2022, Şişecam developed a total of nine products, including five temperable double silver 30% permeability performance products with different reflection colors and aesthetic features (Smoked, Bronze, Blue, Silver, Neutral), and four temperable triple silver 50% and 60% permeability performance products. For the Solar Low-e product, the most preferred solar control glass for the residential sector, Şişecam successfully completed studies on capacity increase, raw material supply security, and mechanical strength. Solutions at different technology levels were produced and patent applications were filed for birdfriendly glass applications, demanded especially by the American market. In 2023, Şişecam initiated project studies to establish the technological infrastructure required within the company as 5G technology becomes more widespread.

In automotive glasses, Şişecam developed HUD (Head-Up Display) windshields and started mass production. Studies are underway to develop innovative technologies for adjusting the light permeability of roof glasses. Tactile and visual functionality were loaded on the glasses to boost comfort and visualization. Energy-generating glass prototypes were developed for electric vehicles. Studies are currently underway for automotive glasses that can meet the requirements of autonomous driving technology. For this purpose, numerical models were developed to determine the optical performance of automotive glasses. Prototype productions of lightened glass studies were realized to reduce vehicle weight. Studies are ongoing to lower costs and reduce plastic material use by integrating antennas into automotive glasses. Studies are also ongoing to design heating systems for automotive glasses; similar studies were completed for marine and air vehicles this year. A process design independent of thickness, aimed at boosting efficiency in the encapsulation process of automotive glasses, was completed and dissemination studies commenced. As a result of work carried out with domestic and foreign paint manufacturers to reduce the cost of automotive paints, Şişecam achieved the target cost advantage with the paint developed and the new paint product began to be used. To simplify and speed up the glass production process, Şişecam is conducting studies on new technologies that can be an alternative to screen printing systems.

Four new products to use with glass fiber reinforced composite products proceeded to production. Among these products, LFT PP multi-end roving, A-Class SMC Multi-End Roving and PP trimming products with detergent resistance, widely used in the automotive and white goods sectors, are standouts. The first prototypes were obtained in the laboratory environment in the Young's Modulus High Glass Fiber (R-Glass) Development project to use in wind turbine blades. The impact of glass fiber raw materials, their production and critical production parameters were examined in detail. Studies were also carried out on operational interventions to boost efficiency.

<!-- image -->

Development studies were completed for the heliostat solar mirror, a key component of the next-generation ecological water-based mirror and tower type concentrated solar power plant. This solar power plant type is of growing importance due to its performance and thus in line with Şişecam's sustainability goals. Both products were added to Şişecam's new product portfolio. Patent applications were filed for the two products.

Şişecam designed and commissioned a system required to produce glass microspheres with a one micron diameter, spherical shape, and a special composition, co-developed with a sector-leading pharmaceutical company in Türkiye to use in cancer treatment. With this system, a glass type used in medical procedures was successfully synthesized and sold for the first time by Şişecam. Testing and approval stages required for the treatment to be approved for application are being carried out by the partner company. A glass composition with linear thermal expansion coefficient of 50-55x10-7/ oC required for vaccine tubes, for which demand has risen sharply in recent years in the pharmaceutical industry, was developed by the machine learning method. Şişecam initiated evaluation studies for regulatory compliance of the samples produced with a small-scale trial production.

This year, Şişecam improved the technology readiness levels of projects carried out on optics, laser, and glass ceramic materials for civil and defense industry use, which are not yet in the company's product portfolio. In particular, development activities to produce optical glasses accelerated with a focus on using different mold materials for shaping and on numerical simulations for process design. Projects to develop thin and light-weighted ballistic resistant laminated glass systems for land and air vehicles in the defense industry are ongoing. As part of lightweighting efforts, Şişecam increased the compressive stress depth of the glass surface with an innovative approach and a multistage chemical tempering method, which includes a heat treatment step. As a result, the breaking load of the glasses increased up to 3x. In addition, bath conditions were optimized using artificial intelligence methods in the chemical tempering process.

Innovative product development activities for glassware products during the year included paint and coating studies with antimicrobial properties, aesthetic decor applications with different effects, new trend color development studies and coating development studies with functional properties such as nondispersibility. An installation of glass products under the name Turkish Glass was designed for participation in Italian Glass Week.

Following laboratory development activities, Şişecam introduced the new color 'Alpine Blue' for glass packaging products via F/H trial production. The new color was warmly received by customers. In glass packaging design activities, Şişecam commercialized seven projects as part of new product, lightweighting, and improvement efforts.

A collaboration was made with a company experienced in the 3D printer sector to develop and produce glass packaging mold part prototypes from different metal materials.

In automotive glasses, Şişecam developed Head-Up Display windshields and started mass production.

## Operational Excellence in Production and Design

In 2022, Şişecam carried out cold repair design projects for nine furnaces; four furnaces were commissioned after cold repair. Eleven furnaces were supported in the procurement process; five furnaces were assembled. Technological upgrades were realized in furnaces repaired in terms of optimum production efficiency and energy efficiency, with modeling and simulation supported designs. In response to material supply constraints for furnace repairs, Şişecam evaluated alternative suppliers. The capacities of existing suppliers were reserved to prevent delays in the targeted furnace maintenance/repair deadlines. In addition, energy efficient furnaces were commissioned at affordable costs.

Şişecam signed a digital furnace monitoring service agreement with a company that provides innovative technology services in the sector for extending the service life of glass melting furnaces and risk management. Thanks to this technology, Şişecam aims to extend the lifespan and prevent unexpected production interruptions by optimizing future interventions for the furnaces.

## Shared capabilities and experience

Studies were carried out for the South Marmara Hydrogen Valley project, of which Şişecam is a partner, in a major step for the company toward fighting climate change and becoming carbon neutral.

Numerical simulations were developed for furnace cold repair projects scheduled for completion in the near future. Design project steps for the furnace that is planned to be Europe's largest capacity flat glass furnace were completed. Efforts to optimize operating conditions of furnaces and production lines for different production demands were supported during the year. Şişecam developed optimal designs for cooling systems, a critical component that determines furnace life. At the same time, the specific fuel consumption effect, sequence, and direction of operating conditions in flat glass furnaces were determined by machine learning.

This year, Şişecam realized lowiron flat glass production for the architectural and solar sector. The transition was supported by furnace operations to improve glass optical performance and ensure cost advantage. Production efficiency and glass quality were improved by supporting 20 color transitions. Melting and affinity performance for 30 alternative raw materials and glass cullet was evaluated in comparison with existing ones. In addition, Şişecam evaluated eight frits via analysis and laboratory studies to obtain the colorants used in F/H coloring from alternative and domestic suppliers.

To delay/prevent corrosion reactions that may occur during and after storage of existing low-e coated products, Şişecam carried out optimization studies by packaging type. As a result, production efficiency and stocking processes were improved. By optimizing the production parameters during flat glass production, the surface quality of flat glasses produced especially for 2 and 3 silver coated products was improved. In addition, the quality and efficiency of secondary processes used to convert coated glasses into the final product were increased due to this optimization effort.

Şişecam conducted improvement studies of glass composition for post-wash deterioration in handmade crystalline glass products. Collaborations were entered into with local companies as part of paint formulation development studies that contribute to operational excellence in glassware products, comply with regulatory and quality requirements, and create cost advantages. In addition, as an alternative to standard bottle/jar bottom knurls, Şişecam studied knurl designs to reduce tumbling and cracking issues. An improvement project for engraving cracks commenced this year. As part of mold design and analysis efforts, Şişecam conducted studies on cooling systems, tumbling analysis, and additive manufacturing optimization.

In 2022, Şişecam carried out required analyses and characterizations with advanced technology devices and different methods. The commissioning of a Raman spectrometer deepened studies on the structural analysis of materials. By using the ellipsometer technique, early-stage corrosion reactions were ensured to be detectable. A dynamic corrosion tester was commissioned to observe abrasions caused by the interaction of furnace refractories with glass during production.

## Energy, Process Efficiency and the Environment

To achieve its sustainability targets, Şişecam is focusing on reducing the carbon footprint of its production operations. Mathematical model studies were carried out to design hybrid type glass melting furnaces that will reduce fossil fuel consumption in glass melting furnaces and allow partial substitution with electrical energy. Technological research processes related to the fully electric melting furnace were completed during the year.

Practical studies on the installation of wind and solar power plants, hydrogen production and/or supply from these plants, and electricity and hot/cold water generation from flue gas waste heat are ongoing. Efficiency improvement works are underway on the current 6.2 MWp and 87 kWp rooftop solar power plants.

This year, the CleanOx Preheating project, which aims to conserve energy in glassware furnaces with innovative waste heat recovery technology supported by the EU LIFE fund, was completed. Thanks to this project, Şişecam gained significant competencies in heat recovery systems in oxygen furnaces for the future.

Şişecam conducted project studies to prevent or minimize unnecessary energy use, waste energy, energy losses, and leakages via various methods, such as energy efficient equipment and systems, as well as through change and process modification. With these efforts, efficiency-enhancing project applications were made to the Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources. The evaluation process is ongoing.

Studies were conducted to boost cullet use to reach decarbonization goals. Şişecam took part in an international project evaluating the use of carbonate-free raw materials. For the Aware glassware series, a collection produced with 100% cullet, production was supported with studies to control glass color and improve quality.

## National and International Integration/Intellectual and Industrial Rights

Collaborations were made with 77 universities (40 national, 37 international), research institutions, and R&amp;D units as part of corporate R&amp;D activities. In the Design Center, a total of 36 collaborations were undertaken with different designers and organizations worldwide.

Şişecam actively participates in a variety of international support programs. Studies were carried out within the South Marmara Hydrogen Valley project, of which Şişecam is a partner. This effort is a major step for Şişecam towards fighting climate change and becoming a carbon neutral company. Under this project, Şişecam initiated studies on the use of green hydrogen in the flat glass production process in line with its CareforNext sustainability approach.

An application was filed for the CET (Clean Energy Transition) Partnership Joint Call 2022 project with a consortium formed between Italy, Finland, Spain, and Türkiye in the field of perovskite-based building integrated photovoltaic technologies.

An application was submitted for the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Networks 2022 project with a consortium formed between Ireland, Italy, Sweden, Slovakia, Malaysia, Germany, Spain, and Türkiye in the field of sustainable coating production technologies.

In the area of solar mirror performance, the CSP Era.Net project is ongoing with the German Solar Institute and METU-GUNAM.

Activities related to two EU Life+ projects are ongoing in the field of smart oxy-boost technology to reduce energy consumption and lower emissions of glass melting furnaces and of CleanOx technology for clean incineration.

A Horizon 2020 project was carried out in the field of supercritical CO 2 for industrial waste heat recovery.

Şişecam is also an active participant in various national support programs. A project application was submitted in the field of coating technologies to the TÜBİTAK 1711-Artificial Intelligence Ecosystem Call. The application was accepted and project studies were initiated.

Under the TÜBİTAK 1004-Center of Excellence Support Program, Şişecam is conducting ongoing projects in conjunction with Bilkent-UNAM and METU-GUNAM on solar energy, fiber reinforcement, and laser technologies. Two new TÜBİTAK 1004 project applications were filed with BilkentUNAM and METU-GUNAM in 2022.

A bird-friendly glass development project was carried out as part of the TÜBİTAK 1505-University-Industry Cooperation Support Program.

Under the TEYDEB 2244-Industry Doctorate Program, nine projects are ongoing with 23 doctoral students from METU, GTU, Marmara, Sabancı, Özyeğin, YTU, and Bilkent universities.

As part of its sustainability targets, Şişecam aims to reduce the carbon footprint of its production operations. To this end, studies were carried out to design a hybrid type glass melting furnace that reduces fossil fuel use in glass melting furnaces and allows partial substitution with electrical energy. Technological research processes related to the fully electric melting furnace were completed during the year.

The technology readiness level of a project on reinforced and lightened glass systems supported within the Defense Industry R&amp;D Wide Area Call was advanced during the year.

In 2022, Şişecam filed eight patent applications, eight patent registrations, six PCT/EPO applications, and 78 design registration applications. Currently, Şişecam has 85 active inventions, of which 51 were registered and 34 are in the process of registration. In addition, Şişecam has intellectual property protection for 933 design registrations for glassware and 295 design registrations for glass packaging products.

As part of TS EN ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory accreditation requirements, TÜRKAK audits were successfully completed this year.

In 2022, Şişecam shared its R&amp;D and design competence and experience on various national and international academic platforms by presenting 25 papers and 13 articles. A total of 22 trainings were provided to production teams and universities during the year.

Şişecam 37 th  International Glass Conference was held as hybrid event on November 17-18, 2022 at the Sheraton Grand Istanbul-Ataşehir Hotel. As part of International Year of Glass activities, Şişecam presented 74 papers (56 oral and 18 poster) at the conference and reached 291 physical and 414 online audience members from 39 countries on five continents.

## Şişecam quality management

To improve its technical processes, Şişecam identified specific actions with a focus on customer expectations and demands.

Under the Şişecam quality vision, Şişecam developed the Quality Management Model to ensure a proactive quality approach based on process and risk analysis in all operational areas and at all company facilities. The Quality Management Model aims to foster process risk analyses at all Şişecam production locations, reduce errors in process steps with control plans, and ensure long-term sustainability with effective problem-solving methods.

Pursuant to the requirements of Şişecam's management systems, external audits for certification were conducted during the year. The audits were successfully concluded and the certifications were renewed. Product certification processes were executed in parallel with sector requirements in Şişecam's fields of activity.

As part of digitalization efforts, Şişecam completed the update of the S4Hana quality module, which was commissioned in the glassware business area. The design step of the same project was successfully realized in efforts to expand the quality module to all Şişecam business areas. Subsequent steps of the project are ongoing for it to go live by the end of 2023.

Şişecam initiated procedural and systematic studies in coordination with Supply Chain units to improve supplier management effectiveness. Supplier quality assessment question lists were develop to analyze the processes of the company's critical suppliers and identify improvement areas. In second quarter 2022, Şişecam conducted audits for 10 new suppliers and 57 existing suppliers. As part of supplier development activities, various actions were taken in response to supplier-related issues.

To support sales strategies in target markets, Şişecam managed a total of 307 test and analysis processes, completed 46 product certifications, and provided over 1,500 customer declarations. The company submitted 12 international standard opinions and attended the activities of technical committees for specific product groups.

To improve technical processes, actions were identified with a focus on customer expectations and demands.

As part of quality operations, Şişecam implemented loss minimization projects with Kaizen, 6 Sigma, and Project Management approaches to exemplify all production groups.

Under THE REGULATION ON REGISTRATION, EVALUATION, AUTHORIZATION AND RESTRICTION OF CHEMICALS (KKDIK/Turkish REACH) published in the Official Gazette dated June 23, 2017 and numbered 30105 (in duplicate) in Türkiye, efforts were carried out for the pre-registration process of one ton and above chemicals imported to use at Şişecam's production facilities. A roadmap was developed with the necessary actions for the full registration process, which is mandatory by December 31, 2023.

## Smart Şişecam

On the digital twin architecture, initial testing of the analytics models developed to optimize furnace natural gas consumption commenced at Yenişehir Glass Packaging. End-toend digital twins of the processes at Balıkesir Fiber and Bursa Yenişehir Flat Glass factories were also developed during the year. This effort resulted in digitalized data collection via 4,500 sensors, monitoring of variables related to metrics identified via cockpits, and more effective decision-making mechanisms.

As part of data governance efforts at Şişecam, the expansion of cockpits is underway to improve data quality, manage clean master data, and measure critical success factors with fast reporting, facilitate data-driven decision-making, enable forecasting, and simplify modeling. Modeling with advanced analytics and machine learning algorithms has commenced.

## One Şişecam Transformation

To have the necessary flexibility and infrastructure to adapt to the new world order and fast changing global environment, all Şişecam Group companies were consolidated under the roof of 'One Şişecam.' This new structure was adopted for more effective management of operations spread across four continents in different business lines. The organizational transformation focused on developing an operational model based on functional principles, strengthening the digital infrastructure by pursuing operational excellence, and engaging in human resource development in line with a global operating model and evaluating human resources according to the new functional structure. The harmonization of human resources and parallel systems was carried out in stages. The transformation of 15 more business functions was completed in 2022 in a process that started with transforming Financial Affairs and Human Resources in early 2021. About 4,396 employees were evaluated using nine different assessment tools and placed in their new roles with the active participation of relevant management teams. Employees were informed through well-attended communication meetings held at different stages of the transformation. Personnel-related needs for the adaptation process were supported via various programs of Şişecam Academy. As the second stage of the transformation of the business model, the functioning of the organizational structure was reviewed while work for physical restructuring in line with the transformation was initiated.

## One Şişecam People and Culture Program

As an integral part of the One Şişecam transformation journey, the One Şişecam People and Culture Program was designed to focus on corporate culture, values, ways of working, competencies and a career management model. Within the program, the future concepts of Culture, Values and Leadership are to be addressed. The focus is

on shaping and strengthening the corporate culture around core values that are adopted and internalized by all Şişecam employees.

The Culture, Values and Leadership concepts of the future are addressed and reinforced via field studies, taking into account the unique dynamics of each production facility. This approach ensures that these concepts become widespread at production facilities in terms of collaboration and cooperation. These efforts are aimed at creating an inclusive and positive communication environment that bolsters cooperation and collaboration, developing activities to ensure that employees internalize and implement the elements reflecting Şişecam's culture and values, and implementing methods to ensure integration with other human resources processes and practices. In addition, the BehaviorFocused Occupational Health and Safety approach further supports these efforts. Under this approach, employees adopt OHS principles and achieve permanent behavioral changes. Safe and unsafe behaviors are analyzed, actions are determined based on observational data, and studies are carried out to replace unsafe behaviors with safe behaviors. Career development and rewarding systems are restructured under the Business Architecture and Career Management and Job Evaluation and Remuneration studies. These efforts address the renewed organizational structure and the implemented career lanes as a whole. Leadership schools are being redesigned with renewed values and leadership competencies. In addition, new leadership trainings are being planned. These integrated efforts are focused on orienting the One Şişecam culture and leadership approach towards the future, developing the skills that maintain working peace in production facilities, embodying the career management approach required by the functional structure via behavioral and technical competency definitions, and redesigning the job evaluation and remuneration strategy and the total rewarding model. Efforts were supported by focus group studies, facility visits, and country-specific workshops. One-on-one interviews were conducted comprehensively through the Culture Survey, 2022 Employee Engagement Survey, and OHS Culture Survey. In line with changing workforce expectations,

<!-- image -->

Şişecam prioritized responding to employees' search for meaning and adapting to new working models. Work is ongoing at Şişecam to design the business model of the future, align skills and competencies, and implement people-oriented business design on a global scale.

## Talent Management and Leadership Development

The Global Talent Management Program Journey aims to develop high-potential employees and prepare them for leadership roles at Şişecam. The program's integrated structure which includes resource management, career management, succession, and development management systems - enables end-to-end management of talent at the company. Şişecam designs training and development journeys that provide a customized experience for the employee. The entire experience process is closely monitored. To facilitate measuring the impact on business results on an individual basis and boosting development performance, Şişecam supports mutual learning via development programs including executive and strategic leadership topics, coaching support, mentoring experience, and learning and sharing seminars.

## Performance and Reward System

Aiming to transform individual based targets into sustainable and successful business results, the final outputs of the Performance Development System are used as a key input in development, talent management, rewarding, remuneration, and career management processes at Şişecam. Successful projects that contribute to business results are rewarded in various categories under the 'Stars of the Year' program. Exemplary behavior and exceptional achievements of company employees who create value with innovative their approaches are recognized with the Instant Rewarding application. The NAR Suggestion Development system, a major application for fostering a growth and innovation perspective, aims to reveal new and unique applications or approaches at Şişecam. This platform provides the opportunity to transform ideas into projects and encourages the sharing of ideas by rewarding successful suggestions.

## AWARDED SUGGESTIONS

## Remuneration Management

With the aim of ensuring equal rights for all employees, Şişecam standardizes all its remuneration and benefits-related solutions, systems, processes and procedures globally, while taking local regulations and dynamics into consideration. To attract the human resources required to the organization while creating a positive working environment by maintaining existing employee loyalty at a high level, Şişecam adopts a fair, stable and high-performance remuneration policy. In 2022, Şişecam made wage adjustments in different periods of the year taking into account individual performance and job level factors. The company took this action to maintain its competitive position in current market conditions, support the purchasing power of its employees and harmonize its remuneration structure with the wage market.

## Healthy individual, safe workplace

Şişecam carries out efforts to boost its occupational health and safety performance, continuously improve processes, create sustainable healthy and safe working environments, effect a positive paradigm shift in employees about the OHS approach, and thus change behaviors and habits.

## Administrative Affairs and Safety

Administrative Affairs and Security activities at Şişecam are managed in accordance with the principles of operational excellence and effective resource management in a structure that ensures employee satisfaction. In 2022, Şişecam aimed to deliver these services on a global scale, via a digital infrastructure and in accordance with a turnkey service model in all activities carried out, especially in food, cleaning, fleet management, staff transportation and security services. Many activities were realized for the digitalization and effective management of business processes.

As part of fleet services management, Şişecam is conducting studies to improve the employee driving experience, offer a safer journey, and ensure optimization in services. Hybrid vehicle use was introduced to effect fuel savings, lower emissions and support Şişecam's CareforNext strategy. In catering services, Şişecam boosted satisfaction by ensuring standardization across plant locations. Work was initiated to provide catering services in a flexible and optional structure in line with the business model of the future. In security services, efforts are focused on auditing the existing security structure and identifying areas for improvement. In line with the standardization of security technologies, Şişecam is focused on technology-intensive applications in physical security. More flexible and faster actions are planned with mobile solutions. Work is underway to manage call services with a professional service approach via a digital platform.

In line its mission to protect its cultural heritage for future generations, Şişecam completed the authentication and appraisal study of the Art Painting Collection in cooperation with Mimar Sinan Fine Arts University.

<!-- image -->

## Industrial Relations

In accordance with company policies, Şişecam continuously improves its occupational health and safety practices at its workplaces under the 'People First' principle. Şişecam boosts its competitiveness and efficiency with consistent and healthy industrial relations. The company works closely with labor unions to maintain labor peace based on trust and dialogue. Şişecam maintains industrial relations with a total of 15 labor unions - four in Türkiye, and 11 in other countries. Negotiations for the expired Collective Labor Agreements started as of the end of 2021 and were finalized in 2022 as part of union negotiation efforts.

<!-- image -->

In addition to the agreements concluded in 2022, Şişecam Chemicals Mersin Soda Chromium Factories and Salt Enterprises Workplace Collective Bargaining Agreement with Petrol-İş Union, Denizli Glass Factory Workplace Collective Bargaining Agreement with Çimse-İş Union, and Camiş Packaging Tuzla Factory Workplace Collective Bargaining Agreement with Selüloz-İş Union are conducted across Türkiye. Outside Türkiye, Collective Bargaining Agreements are being concluded for three workplaces in Bulgaria, Glassware Russia Factory, Glass Packaging Georgia Factory, and Automotive Slovakia Factory. Flat Glass North and South Italy Factories and Şişecam Automotive Germany Factory are covered by National Collective Bargaining Agreements in the respective countries.

## Occupational Health and Safety

Şişecam sees the health and safety of everyone in its ecosystem as its top priority. Accordingly, Şişecam implements an Occupational Health and Safety Policy based on the principle of 'Healthy individuals, safe workplace.' Şişecam aims to adopt local and global examples of good OHS practices, conduct OHS risk assessments with employee participation, and reach an acceptable risk level. The company also strives to go beyond merely meeting legal and regulatory obligations, relevant standards, and other OHS requirements. Efforts are carried out with a proactive approach to boost the company's OHS performance with the involvement of the entire ecosystem. Şişecam aims to effect positive change in its OHS approach, continuously improve processes, create sustainable healthy and safe working environments, and permanently change behaviors and habits.

The OHS scorecard plays a central role in promoting an OHS culture in workplaces and creating a safe working environment at Şişecam. Key performance indicators of employees related to occupational health and safety are digitally monitored instantly and periodically evaluated at OHS Board Meetings. Mandatory OHS trainings and health services at company workplaces in Türkiye are conducted. Risk management activities and actions are monitored digitally. Pilot studies were initiated to include artificial intelligence systems in OHS solutions with the developing technology. Expansion work will proceed for systems that are found effective. Awareness activities are organized to generate OHS awareness among Şişecam employees and foster a safety culture in company workplaces.

## Efforts to Fight Covid-19

In Türkiye, Şişecam renewed its TSE Covid-19 Safe Production Certificates as part of efforts to protect the health of employees against the pandemic. As the number of Covid-19 cases decreased, precautionary measures were reduced gradually and in a controlled manner. Cases continue to be monitored on a weekly basis. All necessary resources, equipment, and infrastructure are constantly reviewed and made available so that all measures can be taken quickly if case numbers start trending upward again.

## A) Report on the Audit of the Consolidated Financial Statements

## 1) Opinion

We have audited the consolidated financial statements of Türkiye Şişe ve Cam Fabrikaları Anonim Şirketi (the Company) and its subsidiaries (the Group), which comprise the consolidated statement of financial position as at 31 December 2022, and the consolidated statement of comprehensive income, consolidated statement of changes in equity and consolidated statement of cash flows for the year then ended, and notes to the consolidated financial statements, including a summary of significant accounting policies.

In our opinion, the accompanying consolidated financial statements present fairly, in all material respects, the consolidated financial position of the Group as at 31 December 2022, and its consolidated financial performance and its consolidated cash flows for the year then ended in accordance with the Turkish Financial Reporting Standards (TFRS).

## 2) Basis for Opinion

We conducted our audit in accordance with standards on auditing as issued by the Capital Markets Board of Turkey and Independent Auditing Standards (InAS) which are part of the Turkish Auditing Standards as issued by the Public Oversight Accounting and Auditing Standards Authority of Turkey (POA). Our responsibilities under those standards are further described in the Auditor's Responsibilities for the Audit of the Consolidated Financial Statements section of our report. We are independent of the Group in accordance with the Code of Ethics for Independent Auditors (Code of Ethics) as issued by the POA, and we have fulfilled our other ethical responsibilities in accordance with the Code of Ethics. We believe that the audit evidence we have obtained is sufficient and appropriate to provide a basis for our opinion.

## 3) Key Audit Matters

Key audit matters are those matters that, in our professional judgment, were of most significance in our audit of the consolidated financial statements of the current period. These matters were addressed in the context of our audit of the consolidated financial statements as a whole, and in forming our opinion thereon, and we do not provide a separate opinion on these matters.

## 4) Responsibilities of Management and Those Charged with Governance for the Consolidated Financial Statements

Management is responsible for the preparation and fair presentation of the consolidated financial statements in accordance with TFRS, and for such internal control as management determines is necessary to enable the preparation of consolidated financial statements that are free from material misstatement, whether due to fraud or error.

In preparing the consolidated financial statements, management is responsible for assessing the Group's ability to continue as a going concern, disclosing, as applicable, matters related to going concern and using the going concern basis of accounting unless management either intends to liquidate the Group or to cease operations, or has no realistic alternative but to do so.

Those charged with governance are responsible for overseeing the Group's financial reporting process.

## 5) Auditor's Responsibilities for the Audit of the Consolidated Financial Statements

In an independent audit, our responsibilities as the auditors are:

Our objectives are to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the consolidated financial statements as a whole are free from material misstatement, whether due to fraud or error, and to issue an auditor's report that includes our opinion. Reasonable assurance is a high level of assurance, but is not a guarantee that an audit conducted in accordance with standards on auditing as issued by the Capital Markets Board of Turkey and InAS will always detect a material misstatement when it exists. Misstatements can arise from fraud or error and are considered material if, individually or in the aggregate, they could reasonably be expected to influence the economic decisions of users taken on the basis of these consolidated financial statements.

As part of an audit in accordance with standards on auditing as issued by the Capital Markets Board of Turkey and InAS, we exercise professional judgment and maintain professional skepticism throughout the audit. We also:

- -Identify and assess the risks of material misstatement of the consolidated financial statements, whether due to fraud or error, design and perform audit procedures responsive to those risks, and obtain audit evidence that is sufficient and appropriate to provide a basis for our opinion. The risk of not detecting a material misstatement resulting from fraud is higher than for one resulting from error, as fraud may involve collusion, forgery, intentional omissions, misrepresentations, or the override of internal control.
- -Obtain an understanding of internal control relevant to the audit in order to design audit procedures that are appropriate in the circumstances, but not for the purpose of expressing an opinion on the effectiveness of the Group's internal control.
- -Evaluate the appropriateness of accounting policies used and the reasonableness of accounting estimates and related disclosures made by management. (Convenience translation of a report and consolidated financial statements originally issued in Turkish)

## NOTES TO THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FOR THE PERIOD 1 JANUARY - 31 DECEMBER 2022

(Amounts expressed in thousand Turkish Lira ('TRY') unless otherwise indicated.)

## 1. In Group's Organization and Nature of Operations

Türkiye Şişe ve Cam Fabrikaları A.Ş. Group (the 'Group') consists of a holding company, Türkiye Şişe ve Cam Fabrikaları  A.Ş. (the 'Company'), 56 subsidiaries, 1 joint venture 2 associates and 1 joint activities.

The Group consists of  six operating segments including companies operating in architectural  glass, automotive glass, glass packaging,  glassware,  chemicals  (soda,  chromium,  and  other  chemicals),  and  others  (export,  import,  energy,  collection, s eparation, processing, recycling and acquisition of packing waste and insurance agency services). The Group's main area of activity  is  glass  production,  and  it  deals  with  complementary  industrial  and  commercial  operations  for  glass  production, Additionally, the Group participates in management of various industrial and commercial companies.

The Group was established 87 years ago by Türkiye İş Bankası A . Ş . ('İş Bankası') in Turkey, being one of the largest Turkish private commercial banks, as of Türkiye Şişe ve Cam Fabrikaları A . Ş . Sosyetesi was founded with the title and registered with the trade registry on January 23, 1936. And the establishment was announced in the trade registry gazette on February 5, 1936. Company's title ha s been registered as of Türkiye Şişe ve Cam Fabrikaları  A.Ş. on April 25, 1973 and published in the trade registry gazette on May 10, 1973. The shares of the Company have been publicly traded on the Borsa İstanbul A.Ş. ('BIST'), formerly  named  as  Istanbul  Stock  Exchange  ('ISE'),  since  January  3,  1986 ,  As  of  December  31,  2022 ,  İş  Bankası  holds 51,06% of the shares and retains the control of the Group.

## The Head Office and the Shareholder Structure of the Company

The shareholder structure of the Company is disclosed in Note 28.

The Company is registered in Turkey and the headquarters address is İçmeler Mahallesi D -100 Karayolu Cad, No:44 A 34947, Tuzla / İstanbul / Türkiye

## 2. Basis of Presentation of Consolidated Financial Statements

## 2.1 Basis of Presentation

The accompanying consolidated financial statements are prepared in accordance with Communiqué Serial II, No: 14 , 1, 'Principles of Financial Reporting in Capital Markets' ('the Communiqué') published in the Official Gazette numbered 28676 on 13 June 2013. According to Article 5 of the Communiqué, consolidated financial statements are prepared in accordance with the Turkish Accounting  Standard  issued  by  Public  Oversight  Accou nting  and  Auditing  Standards  Authority  ('POA / ASA') ,  TAS  contains Turkish Accounting Standards, Turkish Financial Reporting Standards ('TFRS') and its addendum and interpretations ('IFRIC') , In addition, it has been presented in accordance with the formats determined in the "Announcement on TMS Taxonomy" published by the KGK on October 4, 2022 and the Financial Statement Examples and User Guide published by the CMB.

The Company (and its subsidiaries ,Joint Activities and Joint Ventures registered in Turkey) maintains its accounting records and prepares its statutory financial statements in accordance with the Turkish Commercial Code (the 'TCC'), tax legislation and t he uniform chart of accounts issued by the Ministry of Finance, subsidiaries, joint ventures, associates and joint activties operating in foreign countries have prepared their statutory financial statements in accordance with the laws and regulations of the country in which they operate. The year end consolidated financial statements, except for the financial asset and liabilities presented with their fair values, are maintained under historical cost conversion in TRY. This year end consolidated financial statements are based  on  the  statutory  records,  which  are  maintained  under  historical  cost  conversion,  with  the  required  adjustments  and reclassifications reflected for the purpose of fair presentation in accordance with the TAS.

## Presentation and Functional Currency

The individual financial statements of each Group entity are presented in its currency where the entity operates (its functional currency). For the purpose of the consolidated financial statements, the results and financial position of each entity consolidated are expressed in thousand Turkish Lira (TRY), which is the functional of the Company and the presentation currency of the Group. The currencies other than TRY are also expressed in thousands.

## Restatement of Financial Statements in Hyperinflationary Periods

TAS 29 Financial Reporting in Hyperinflation Economies requires entities whose functional currency is that of a hyperinflationary economy to prepare their financial statements in terms of the measuring unit current at the end of the reporting period. TAS 29 describes characteristics that may indicate that an economy is hyperinflationary, and it requires all entities that report in the currency of the same hyperinflationary economy apply this Standard from the same date. Therefore, it is expected that TAS 29 will start to be applied simultaneously by all entities with the announcement of Public Oversight Accounting and Auditing Standards Authority to ensure consistency of the application required by TAS 29 throughout the country.  However, the Authority has not published any announcement that determines entities would restate their financial statements for the accounting period ending on 31 December 2022 in accordance with TAS 29. In this context, TMS 29 is not applied and inflation adjustment has not been reflected in the financial statements as of December 31, 2022.

## Going Concern

The consolidated financial statements including the accounts of the parent company, its subsidiaries, joint ventures, joint activities and associates have been prepared assuming that the Group will continue as a going concern on the basis that the entity will be able to realize its assets and discharge its liabilities in the normal course of business.

## Comparatives and Restatement of Prior Periods Financial Statements

The consolidated financial statements of the Group include comparative financial information to enable the determination of the financial position and performance. Comparative figures are reclassified where necessary, to conform to changes in presentation in the current period consolidated financial statements.

Within this framework, the valuation studies of the subsidiaries in the USA have been completed. Since 31 December 2021, USA subsidiaries have been consolidated with final amounts in accordance with the TFRS-3 "Business Combinations" standard. The effects  of  the  final  amounts  have  been  reflected  in  the  financial  statements  dated  31  December  2022.  Adjustments  of  the subsidiary based on the final results as of 31 December 2021 are shown below.
